title: Electrocardiographic Features in Patients with Neuromuscular Diseases: A Retrospective Analysis.
summary: Background: Neuromuscular diseases (NMDs) are a group of progressive hereditary disorders frequently associated with significant cardiac involvement, which can represent a primary cause of mortality. This study aims to characterize the electrocardiographic findings in patients with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD), Becker Muscular Dystrophy (BMD), and Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 (DM1). Methods: We conducted a retrospective analysis of 131 ECGs from 74 patients (28 DMD, 24 BMD, 22 DM1) followed in the Department of Clinical and Experimental Medicine of the University of Messina, Italy. None of the enrolled patients had clinically manifest heart failure. Electrocardiographic and echocardiographic data were collected, and each ECG finding was considered present if documented in at least one ECG during follow-up. In the DM1 group, an exploratory analysis of the 12-lead P-wave voltage sum (ΣP) and of its ratio to the QRS voltage sum (ΣQRS) was performed and compared with DMD and BMD patients and healthy controls. Results: In DMD patients, the most common findings were deep Q waves (57.1%), negative T waves in the lateral leads (39.3%), and complete and incomplete right bundle branch block (RBBB) (25.0% each). In BMD, incomplete RBBB (27.3%), U waves (27.3%) and left atrial enlargement (23.8%) were prevalent, and 3 patients (12.5%) had a pacemaker. In DM1, atrial fibrillation (18.2%), PR interval prolongation (38.9% of patients in sinus rhythm) and early repolarization (42.9%) were frequent. Mean ΣP and ΣP/ΣQRS values were lower in DM1 patients than in DMD and BMD patients and healthy controls. Conclusions: This study confirms many previously described ECG abnormalities in NMDs and highlights disease-specific patterns. The finding of deep Q waves in DMD may reflect inferolateral fibrosis. Notably, the reduced P-wave voltage in DM1 patients is a novel, hypothesis-generating observation that may reflect atrial myopathy; its value as a predictor of atrial arrhythmias requires prospective validation. These findings underscore the critical role of routine ECG surveillance in the management of patients with NMDs.

AI.tldr: 回顾性分析显示，DMD、BMD与DM1各有特征性心电图表现，DM1患者P波电压总和及P/QRS比值显著降低，提示心房肌病可能。
AI.motivation: 神经肌肉疾病（NMD）常伴显著心脏受累，是患者死亡的主要原因之一，但DMD、BMD与DM1的心电图特征谱及疾病特异性差异尚缺乏系统描述，尤其DM1心房受累的电生理标志物证据不足。
AI.method: 意大利墨西拿大学医院单中心回顾性分析，纳入74例患者（DMD 28例、BMD 24例、DM1 22例）共131份心电图，均无临床心衰表现；收集心电图与超声心动图资料，随访中任一心电图记录到即计为存在；DM1组探索性分析12导联P波电压总和（ΣP）及ΣP/ΣQRS比值，并与DMD、BMD及健康对照比较。
AI.result: DMD最常见为深Q波（57.1%）、侧壁导联T波倒置（39.3%）及完全/不完全性右束支传导阻滞（各25.0%）；BMD以不完全性RBBB（27.3%）、U波（27.3%）、左房增大（23.8%）多见，3例（12.5%）已植入起搏器；DM1常见房颤（18.2%）、PR间期延长（窦律者中38.9%）及早期复极（42.9%）。DM1组平均ΣP及ΣP/ΣQRS比值低于DMD、BMD及健康对照。摘要未报告组间比较的95%CI与P值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实NMD存在多种已知心电图异常并揭示疾病特异性模式：DMD深Q波可能反映下侧壁纤维化，DM1 P波电压降低为新的假设生成性发现，可能反映心房肌病，但其预测房性心律失常的价值需前瞻性验证；结果支持对NMD患者进行常规心电图监测。

summary_zh: 背景：神经肌肉疾病（NMDs）是一组进行性遗传性疾病，常伴有显著的心脏受累，这可能是导致死亡的主要原因。本研究旨在描述杜氏肌营养不良（DMD）、贝克肌营养不良（BMD）和强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1）患者的心电图表现特征。方法：我们对在意大利墨西拿大学临床与实验医学系随访的74例患者（28例DMD、24例BMD、22例DM1）的131份心电图进行了回顾性分析。入组患者均无临床明显的心力衰竭。收集了心电图和超声心动图数据，随访期间至少一份心电图记录到的表现即视为存在。在DM1组中，对12导联P波电压总和（ΣP）及其与QRS电压总和（ΣQRS）的比值进行了探索性分析，并与DMD和BMD患者及健康对照进行比较。结果：在DMD患者中，最常见的心电图表现是深Q波（57.1%）、侧壁导联T波倒置（39.3%）以及完全性和不完全性右束支传导阻滞（RBBB）（各占25.0%）。在BMD中，不完全性RBBB（27.3%）、U波（27.3%）和左心房增大（23.8%）较为常见，3例患者（12.5%）植入了起搏器。在DM1中，心房颤动（18.2%）、PR间期延长（窦性心律患者中占38.9%）和早期复极（42.9%）较为常见。DM1患者的平均ΣP和ΣP/ΣQRS值低于DMD和BMD患者及健康对照。结论：本研究证实了NMDs中许多先前描述的心电图异常，并突出了疾病特异性模式。DMD中发现深Q波可能反映下侧壁纤维化。值得注意的是，DM1患者P波电压降低是一项新的、产生假设的观察结果，可能反映心房肌病；其作为房性心律失常预测因素的价值需要前瞻性验证。这些发现强调了常规心电图监测在NMDs患者管理中的关键作用。

title: Chronological Magnetic Resonance Angiography Demonstration of Spontaneous Posterior Cerebral Artery Recanalization: Unmasking Cardioembolic Stroke and Postprandial Atrial Fibrillation Mislabeled as Dumping Syndrome.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and post-gastrectomy dumping syndrome share overlapping symptoms, such as palpitations, dizziness, and chest discomfort, making them clinically difficult to distinguish. We report a case where anchoring bias led both the patient and clinicians to misattribute postprandial symptoms to dumping syndrome, until a cardioembolic stroke unmasked latent AF. A 63-year-old man with a history of distal gastrectomy performed 5 years prior developed postprandial palpitations, chest discomfort, and dizziness triggered by rapid eating or cold drinks. A prior facility had empirically attributed these episodes to dumping syndrome without cardiac evaluation. Initial electrocardiogram showed normal sinus rhythm. The next day, he developed acute diplopia and ptosis due to left oculomotor nerve palsy. Brain MRI demonstrated a left medial midbrain infarction, and MR angiography (MRA) showed 99% stenosis of the left P1 segment. Transesophageal echocardiography demonstrated left atrial enlargement and decreased left atrial appendage flow velocity with spontaneous echo contrast. Continuous electrocardiographic telemetry post-dinner captured paroxysmal AF, unmasking the arrhythmia. His CHA2DS2-VASc and HAS-BLED scores were calculated as 3 and 2, respectively. He was treated with anticoagulants and discharged with mild sequelae (modified Rankin Scale score 1). Follow-up MRA at 3 months showed complete recanalization of the P1 segment. This chronological MRA sequence provided visual proof differentiating cardioembolism from fixed intracranial atherosclerosis.

AI.tldr: 63岁胃切除术后患者餐后心悸、头晕被误诊为倾倒综合征，后发生心源性栓塞性卒中，连续心电监测捕获阵发性房颤，抗凝治疗后3个月MRA显示大脑后动脉P1段完全再通。
AI.motivation: 房颤与胃切除术后倾倒综合征症状重叠（心悸、头晕、胸部不适），临床难以鉴别；锚定偏倚可导致漏诊房颤，延误抗凝治疗，增加心源性栓塞风险。既往缺乏类似病例的影像学动态证据。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为1例63岁男性，5年前行远端胃切除术，餐后出现心悸、胸部不适、头晕，既往被经验性诊断为倾倒综合征。本次因急性左侧动眼神经麻痹就诊，行脑MRI、MRA、经食管超声心动图及连续心电遥测监测。主要观察指标为房颤检出、卒中病因分型及MRA血管再通情况。
AI.result: 初始心电图示正常窦性心律。脑MRI示左侧中脑内侧梗死，MRA示左侧大脑后动脉P1段99%狭窄。经食管超声示左房扩大、左心耳血流速度减低伴自发显影。晚餐后连续心电遥测捕获阵发性房颤。CHA2DS2-VASc评分3分，HAS-BLED评分2分。抗凝治疗后出院，改良Rankin量表评分1分。3个月随访MRA示P1段完全再通。
AI.conclusion: 连续心电监测有助于揭示被误诊为倾倒综合征的餐后阵发性房颤；动态MRA序列可区分心源性栓塞与固定性颅内动脉粥样硬化。临床遇胃切除术后餐后心悸、头晕患者应警惕房颤，避免锚定偏倚。本报告为单例，结论外推受限。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）与胃切除术后倾倒综合征具有重叠症状，如心悸、头晕和胸部不适，临床上难以区分。我们报告一例因锚定偏倚导致患者和临床医生均将餐后症状误归因于倾倒综合征，直至心源性栓塞性卒中揭示了潜在AF的病例。一名63岁男性，5年前曾行远端胃切除术，因快速进食或冷饮诱发餐后心悸、胸部不适和头晕。此前一家机构经验性将这些发作归因于倾倒综合征，未进行心脏评估。初始心电图显示正常窦性心律。次日，他因左侧动眼神经麻痹出现急性复视和上睑下垂。脑MRI显示左侧中脑内侧梗死，MR血管造影（MRA）显示左侧P1段99%狭窄。经食管超声心动图显示左心房扩大和左心耳血流速度减低伴自发性回声增强。晚餐后连续心电遥测捕捉到阵发性AF，揭示了该心律失常。其CHA2DS2-VASc和HAS-BLED评分分别计算为3分和2分。他接受抗凝治疗，出院时遗留轻度后遗症（改良Rankin量表评分1分）。3个月随访MRA显示P1段完全再通。这一时间顺序的MRA序列为区分心源性栓塞与固定性颅内动脉粥样硬化提供了视觉证据。

Device malfunction following epicardial pulsed field ablation using a focal dual energy ablation catheter in a patient with cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is increasingly used, but experience with ventricular, and particularly epicardial, applications in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) remains limited.

CASE SUMMARY: A 49-year-old woman with LMNA- and SCN5A-associated cardiomyopathy, mildly reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (45%), and a cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator (CRT-D) presented with recurrent ventricular tachycardia (VT) and implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shocks. Previous endocardial VT ablation had revealed no relevant endocardial low-voltage substrate.Repeat ablation was performed using a combined endo-epicardial approach. Epicardial mapping identified extensive low-voltage areas, with the best pace-map match at the basal lateral left ventricle. Ablation was performed using a focal dual-energy catheter with radiofrequency energy up to 40 W and PFA (2400 V).Following epicardial PFA in proximity to the device generator and left ventricular lead, pacing abruptly changed from VVI 30/min to DDD 70/min. Initial attempts at device interrogation failed. After communication was restored, interrogation demonstrated that the CRT-D had reverted to factory settings. The device was successfully reset and reprogrammed. Further PFA near the LV lead or generator was avoided. Sensing, pacing thresholds, and lead impedances were preserved.

DISCUSSION: To our knowledge, this is the first report of a clinically relevant transient CIED malfunction temporally associated with epicardial ventricular PFA using a focal single-tip dual-energy ablation catheter. Although no permanent generator or lead dysfunction occurred, this observation highlights the potential for PFA-CIED interactions beyond conventional PFA workflows and across different catheter technologies.

AI.tldr: 一例CRT-D患者在心外膜脉冲场消融后出现设备短暂重置为出厂设置，提示PFA与CIED存在潜在相互作用。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）应用日益广泛，但在心室尤其心外膜应用时，对心脏植入式电子设备（CIED）的影响经验有限，临床缺乏相关安全性数据。
AI.method: 病例报告。49岁女性，LMNA和SCN5A相关心肌病，LVEF 45%，CRT-D，因复发性室速和ICD放电入院。既往心内膜消融未见低电压基质，本次采用内外膜联合入路，使用焦点双能量导管（射频40W，PFA 2400V）行心外膜消融。
AI.result: 心外膜标测发现广泛低电压区，最佳起搏标测位于左室基底侧壁。在靠近设备发生器和左室导线附近行心外膜PFA后，起搏模式从VVI 30/min突变为DDD 70/min，初始设备询问失败，恢复通讯后显示CRT-D重置为出厂设置。重新设置后，感知、起搏阈值和导线阻抗均保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 这是首例报道焦点单尖双能量导管心外膜心室PFA后出现临床相关短暂CIED功能异常，虽无永久性设备或导线功能障碍，但提示PFA-CIED相互作用可能超出常规PFA流程并涉及不同导管技术，临床需警惕。

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）的应用日益广泛，但在植入心脏电子装置（CIED）的患者中，心室尤其是心外膜应用的经验仍然有限。

病例摘要：一名49岁女性，患有LMNA和SCN5A相关心肌病，左心室射血分数轻度降低（45%），并植入了心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D），因反复发作室性心动过速（VT）和植入式心律转复除颤器电击就诊。既往心内膜VT消融未发现相关的心内膜低电压基质。采用心内膜-心外膜联合方法再次进行消融。心外膜标测发现广泛低电压区，最佳起搏标测匹配位于左心室基底侧壁。使用聚焦双能量导管进行消融，射频能量高达40 W，并应用PFA（2400 V）。在靠近装置发生器和左心室导线附近进行心外膜PFA后，起搏模式突然从VVI 30次/分变为DDD 70次/分。初始尝试对装置进行程控失败。通信恢复后，程控显示CRT-D已恢复出厂设置。装置成功重置并重新编程。避免在左心室导线或发生器附近进一步进行PFA。感知、起搏阈值和导线阻抗均保持稳定。

讨论：据我们所知，这是首例报告临床相关的短暂性CIED功能障碍，在时间上与使用聚焦单尖端双能量消融导管进行心外膜心室PFA相关。尽管未发生永久性发生器或导线功能障碍，但这一观察结果突显了PFA与CIED之间在传统PFA工作流程之外以及不同导管技术中发生相互作用的可能性。

title: Efficacy and safety of low-power (20 W) catheter ablation for typical atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia: a prospective multicenter study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT) is the most common supraventricular tachycardia. Although catheter ablation is the definitive treatment, atrioventricular (AV) block requiring permanent pacemaker implantation remains a major safety concern.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of a low-power (20 W) slow pathway ablation strategy for typical AVNRT.

METHODS: In this prospective multicenter study, 203 consecutive patients (mean age 54.4 ± 17.3 years; 59.6% women) underwent slow pathway ablation initiated at 20 W, with power escalation as needed. Variables associated with requiring higher power were analyzed using univariable and multivariable logistic regression.

RESULTS: Initial success at 20 W was achieved in 170 patients (83.7%); 33 patients (16.3%) required higher power, with an overall acute success rate of 99.5%. Compared with patients who achieved success at 20 W, those requiring higher power were younger and had higher pre-ablation heart rates. On univariable analysis, younger age [odds ratio [OR] 0.66 per 10-year increase, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.54-0.83; p < 0.001] and higher pre-ablation heart rate (OR 1.88 per 10-bpm increase, 95% CI 1.30-2.73; p < 0.001) were associated with the need for higher power. Transient AV block occurred in 1.9% of patients, and no cases of permanent AV block (0%, 95% CI 0%-1.8%) or pacemaker implantation were observed. During 18.3 ± 4.1 months of follow-up, recurrence occurred in two patients (0.9%).

CONCLUSION: An initial 20 W ablation strategy provides high efficacy with a favorable safety profile and no permanent AV block observed in this cohort. Younger age and a higher baseline heart rate predicted the need for power escalation, supporting an initial low-power approach for AVNRT ablation.

AI.tldr: 低功率（20W）慢径路消融治疗典型AVNRT急性成功率99.5%，无永久性AV阻滞，年轻和基线心率快者需升级功率。
AI.motivation: AVNRT是最常见的室上性心动过速，导管消融是根治手段，但房室阻滞需永久起搏器植入仍是主要安全顾虑，需探索更安全的消融策略。
AI.method: 前瞻性多中心研究，连续纳入203例典型AVNRT患者（平均年龄54.4±17.3岁，女性59.6%），慢径路消融初始功率20W，必要时升级功率。主要观察初始成功率、需升级功率的预测因素、AV阻滞及复发。采用单因素和多因素logistic回归分析需更高功率的相关变量。
AI.result: 20W初始成功170例（83.7%），33例（16.3%）需升级功率，总急性成功率99.5%。需升级功率者更年轻、消融前心率更高。单因素分析显示，年轻（每增加10岁OR 0.66，95%CI 0.54-0.83，P<0.001）和消融前心率快（每增加10bpm OR 1.88，95%CI 1.30-2.73，P<0.001）与需升级功率相关。暂时性AV阻滞发生率1.9%，无永久性AV阻滞（0%，95%CI 0%-1.8%）及起搏器植入。随访18.3±4.1个月，复发2例（0.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 初始20W消融策略高效安全，本队列无永久性AV阻滞，年轻和基线心率快预测需升级功率，支持AVNRT消融采用初始低功率策略。

summary_zh:
背景：房室结折返性心动过速（AVNRT）是最常见的室上性心动过速。尽管导管消融是根治性治疗手段，但需要植入永久起搏器的房室（AV）阻滞仍是主要的安全性顾虑。

目的：评价低功率（20 W）慢径路消融策略治疗典型AVNRT的有效性和安全性。

方法：在这项前瞻性多中心研究中，连续203例患者（平均年龄54.4 ± 17.3岁；59.6%为女性）接受以20 W起始的慢径路消融，必要时上调功率。采用单变量和多变量logistic回归分析与需要更高功率相关的变量。

结果：170例患者（83.7%）在20 W下获得初始成功；33例患者（16.3%）需要更高功率，总体急性成功率为99.5%。与在20 W下获得成功的患者相比，需要更高功率的患者更年轻且消融前心率更高。单变量分析显示，较年轻的年龄[比值比[OR] 每增加10岁为0.66，95%置信区间[CI] 0.54-0.83；p < 0.001]和较高的消融前心率（OR 每增加10 bpm为1.88，95% CI 1.30-2.73；p < 0.001）与需要更高功率相关。一过性AV阻滞发生于1.9%的患者，未观察到永久性AV阻滞（0%，95% CI 0%-1.8%）或起搏器植入的病例。在18.3 ± 4.1个月的随访期间，两例患者（0.9%）复发。

结论：以20 W起始的消融策略提供了高有效性且安全性良好，在该队列中未观察到永久性AV阻滞。较年轻的年龄和较高的基线心率预测需要上调功率，支持对AVNRT消融采用初始低功率策略。

title: Aldosterone-Mediated Atrial Remodeling and Atrial Fibrillation: Molecular Mechanisms, Translational Insights and Implications for Cardiac Surgery.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) has heterogeneous mechanisms, including structural atrial cardiomyopathy, electrical remodeling and primary ion-channel abnormalities. Aldosterone-mineralcorticoid receptor (MR) signaling may contribute to an arrhythmogenic atrial substrate through redox-sensitive, inflammatory, profibrotic and electrophysiological pathways; however, their direct demonstration in human atria varies. Primary aldosteronism is associated with excess AF risk, but circulating aldosterone, renin-independent secretion, tissue MR activation and MR-antagonist exposure are not interchangeable biological measures. This narrative review critically distinguishes evidence from human atrial tissue, atrial experimental systems and extrapolation from other cardiovascular models, with particular emphasis on the cardiac surgical setting. Preoperative aldosterone has been associated with postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF), whereas perioperative MR-antagonist studies have reported discordant findings and observational analyses remain susceptible to confounding. We propose a testable, rather than established, two-hit framework in which a pre-existing endocrine-associated atrial substrate may interact with perioperative inflammation and hemodynamic stress. The review identifies gaps in endocrine phenotyping and the need for adequately powered prospective and interventional studies before aldosterone-directed POAF prevention can be recommended.

AI.tldr: 醛固酮-MR信号可能通过氧化应激、炎症和纤维化促进房颤基质，但人类证据不一致；术前醛固酮与POAF相关，而MR拮抗剂围术期研究结果矛盾，尚不足以推荐醛固酮导向的POAF预防。
AI.motivation: 房颤机制异质，醛固酮-MR信号可能通过 redox 敏感、炎症、促纤维化和电生理通路促心律失常，但人类心房直接证据不一；原发性醛固酮增多症与房颤风险相关，但循环醛固酮、肾素非依赖性分泌、组织MR激活和MR拮抗剂暴露不可互换；需区分人类心房组织、心房实验系统和其他心血管模型证据，尤其心脏外科围术期。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，批判性区分人类心房组织、心房实验系统及从其他心血管模型外推的证据，重点心脏外科场景；未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或定量合成方法。
AI.result: 术前醛固酮与术后房颤（POAF）相关；围术期MR拮抗剂研究结果不一致，观察性分析易受混杂影响；提出可检验但未确立的“二次打击”框架：既存内分泌相关心房基质与围术期炎症和血流动力学应激交互；指出内分泌表型缺口及需足够把握度的前瞻性和干预性研究。
AI.conclusion: 醛固酮导向的POAF预防目前证据不足，不能推荐；临床意义在于识别内分泌相关心房基质可能为POAF高危表型，但需先完善内分泌表型并开展前瞻性干预研究；局限性为叙述性综述、证据异质且缺乏定量合成。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）具有异质性机制，包括结构性心房心肌病、电重构和原发性离子通道异常。醛固酮-盐皮质激素受体（MR）信号可能通过氧化还原敏感、炎症、促纤维化和电生理通路促进致心律失常性心房基质；然而，这些通路在人心房中的直接证据不一。原发性醛固酮增多症与AF风险增加相关，但循环醛固酮、肾素非依赖性分泌、组织MR激活和MR拮抗剂暴露并非可互换的生物学指标。本叙述性综述批判性地区分了来自人心房组织、心房实验系统以及从其他心血管模型外推的证据，特别强调心脏外科手术环境。术前醛固酮与术后心房颤动（POAF）相关，而围术期MR拮抗剂研究报告了不一致的发现，观察性分析仍易受混杂因素影响。我们提出一个可检验而非已确立的“二次打击”框架，其中预先存在的内分泌相关心房基质可能与围术期炎症和血流动力学应激相互作用。本综述指出了内分泌表型分析方面的空白，以及在推荐醛固酮导向的POAF预防之前需要足够效力的前瞻性和干预性研究。

title: Influenza Infection, Newly Diagnosed Atrial Fibrillation, and One-Year Mortality in Hospitalized Adults: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary: Background/Objectives: Whether influenza increases the risk of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation (NDAF) beyond the effect of acute illness is uncertain. We examined whether viral etiology and prior influenza vaccination (exposures) were associated with NDAF within one year (primary outcome), and whether NDAF was associated with one-year all-cause mortality (secondary outcome), in hospitalized adults. Methods: This retrospective cohort study included 21,653 adults hospitalized in Clalit Health Services facilities (2012-2020) who underwent respiratory-virus PCR testing: influenza A (n = 2829), influenza B (n = 992), other respiratory viruses (n = 561), and PCR-negative concurrent controls (n = 17,271). NDAF within 365 days was analyzed with cause-specific Cox and Fine-Gray models, including time windows; mortality with time-dependent Cox models; and vaccination with propensity score matching. Results: NDAF was recorded in 1228 patients (5.7%), 56% of them on the day of admission. Compared with PCR-negative patients, no viral etiology was associated with a higher hazard of NDAF (influenza A: HR 0.87, 95% CI 0.73-1.04; influenza B: HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.53-1.00), including within 30 days and after excluding day-0 events. NDAF was associated with higher one-year mortality (HR 1.68, 95% CI 1.52-1.87), especially when recorded after discharge (HR 3.04). Influenza vaccination was not associated with NDAF (HR 0.97, 95% CI 0.85-1.10). Conclusions: Among hospitalized adults tested for respiratory viruses, neither influenza nor prior vaccination was associated with NDAF compared with PCR-negative inpatients, who were not necessarily of similar acute illness severity. NDAF marked a higher hazard of one-year mortality.

AI.tldr: 在住院成人中，流感病毒感染及既往流感疫苗接种均与新发房颤风险无关，但新发房颤与一年全因死亡风险升高68%相关。
AI.motivation: 流感是否独立于急性疾病严重程度增加新发房颤（NDAF）风险尚不明确，且既往流感疫苗接种对NDAF的影响证据有限。本研究旨在探讨病毒病因和疫苗接种与NDAF的关联，以及NDAF与一年全因死亡率的关系。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2012-2020年Clalit健康服务机构住院并接受呼吸道病毒PCR检测的21,653例成人，分为甲型流感（n=2829）、乙型流感（n=992）、其他呼吸道病毒（n=561）和PCR阴性对照组（n=17,271）。主要终点为365天内NDAF，采用病因特异性Cox和Fine-Gray模型分析；次要终点为一年全因死亡率，采用时间依赖Cox模型；疫苗接种分析采用倾向评分匹配。
AI.result: NDAF发生于1228例（5.7%），其中56%在入院当天记录。与PCR阴性患者相比，任何病毒病因均未增加NDAF风险（甲型流感：HR 0.87，95%CI 0.73-1.04；乙型流感：HR 0.73，95%CI 0.53-1.00），30天内及排除第0天事件后结果一致。NDAF与一年死亡率升高相关（HR 1.68，95%CI 1.52-1.87），出院后记录的NDAF风险更高（HR 3.04）。流感疫苗接种与NDAF无关（HR 0.97，95%CI 0.85-1.10）。
AI.conclusion: 在因呼吸道症状住院并接受病毒检测的成人中，流感病毒感染或既往疫苗接种均未增加NDAF风险，但NDAF是一年死亡风险升高的标志。临床意义在于住院期间新发房颤应被视为不良预后标志，需加强随访管理；局限性包括回顾性设计、PCR阴性对照组急性疾病严重程度可能不匹配，以及未报告具体死亡原因。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：流感是否在急性疾病效应之外增加新诊断心房颤动（NDAF）的风险尚不确定。我们在住院成人中检验了病毒病因和既往流感疫苗接种（暴露因素）是否与一年内NDAF（主要结局）相关，以及NDAF是否与一年全因死亡率（次要结局）相关。方法：这项回顾性队列研究纳入在Clalit Health Services机构（2012-2020年）住院并接受呼吸道病毒PCR检测的21,653名成人：甲型流感（n = 2829）、乙型流感（n = 992）、其他呼吸道病毒（n = 561）和PCR阴性同期对照（n = 17,271）。采用病因特异性Cox模型和Fine-Gray模型分析365天内NDAF，包括时间窗；采用时间依赖性Cox模型分析死亡率；采用倾向评分匹配分析疫苗接种。结果：1228名患者（5.7%）记录了NDAF，其中56%在入院当天记录。与PCR阴性患者相比，无病毒病因与更高的NDAF风险相关（甲型流感：HR 0.87，95% CI 0.73-1.04；乙型流感：HR 0.73，95% CI 0.53-1.00），包括在30天内和排除第0天事件后。NDAF与更高的一年死亡率相关（HR 1.68，95% CI 1.52-1.87），尤其是出院后记录时（HR 3.04）。流感疫苗接种与NDAF无关（HR 0.97，95% CI 0.85-1.10）。结论：在接受呼吸道病毒检测的住院成人中，与PCR阴性住院患者相比，流感或既往疫苗接种均与NDAF无关，而PCR阴性住院患者的急性疾病严重程度不一定相似。NDAF标志着更高的年死亡率风险。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Thrombus and Long-Term Clinical Outcomes in Anticoagulated Patients with Atrial Fibrillation and Atrial Flutter Referred for a Rhythm-Control Strategy: A Prospective Observational Cohort Study.
summary: Background/Objectives: Whether long-term prognosis differs between patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and those with atrial flutter (AFL) after adjustment for baseline cardiovascular characteristics remains unclear. Methods: In this prospective observational cohort study, we enrolled 656 patients meeting predefined anticoagulation eligibility criteria with AF (n = 558) or AFL (n = 98) who underwent transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) before a planned rhythm-control intervention. The primary endpoint was left atrial appendage thrombus (LAAT) detected at the index TEE. Long-term outcomes included cardiovascular death, heart failure (HF) hospitalization, ischemic stroke, transient ischemic attack, myocardial infarction, and systemic thromboembolism. Results: LAAT was detected in 14.2% of patients with AF and 10.2% of patients with AFL (p = 0.29). After multivariable adjustment, AFL versus AF was not independently associated with LAAT (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 0.53; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.25-1.11; p = 0.09). Median follow-up was 6.85 (3.64-8.53) years. Cardiovascular death occurred in 96 patients (14.6%; AF: n = 78, AFL: n = 18), and HF hospitalization occurred in 91 patients (13.9%; AF: n = 78, AFL: n = 13). Log-rank comparisons were not statistically significant for cardiovascular death (log-rank p = 0.42) or HF hospitalization (log-rank p = 0.73). In extended Cox models that accounted for nonproportional hazards, AFL versus AF was not independently associated with cardiovascular death (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR], 1.09; 95% CI, 0.64-1.85; p = 0.75) or HF hospitalization (aHR, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.37-1.27; p = 0.23). Conclusions: Catheter ablation was recorded in 83.7% of AFL versus 24.6% of AF patients, including index-hospitalization ablation in 46.9% versus 0%, respectively. In this selected cohort meeting predefined anticoagulation eligibility criteria referred for TEE-guided rhythm control, no statistically significant independent association was detected between index arrhythmia type (AF versus AFL) and LAAT, cardiovascular death, or HF hospitalization. Importantly, these findings describe associations under markedly different subsequent rhythm-control treatment pathways and do not establish equivalent intrinsic risks for AF and AFL. The smaller AFL group (n = 98) and wide confidence intervals limit precision; clinically meaningful differences cannot be excluded. These findings should not be extrapolated to unselected AF/AFL populations, including asymptomatic patients, those managed exclusively with rate control, or patients not receiving anticoagulation. The comparison is based on presenting arrhythmia, not a rhythm phenotype confirmed to persist throughout follow-up; incident AF among patients initially presenting with AFL was not systematically ascertained.

AI.tldr: 在符合抗凝指征并接受TEE指导节律控制的AF/AFL患者中，AFL与AF相比，左心耳血栓、心血管死亡和心衰住院风险无显著独立差异，但AFL组后续消融比例更高，结论不能外推。
AI.motivation: AF与AFL患者长期预后是否存在差异尚不明确，尤其在校正基线心血管特征后。本研究旨在探讨AF与AFL患者左心耳血栓（LAAT）检出率及长期临床结局的差异。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性队列研究，纳入656例符合预设抗凝指征、计划行节律控制干预前接受经食管超声心动图（TEE）的患者（AF 558例，AFL 98例）。主要终点为TEE检测到的LAAT；长期终点包括心血管死亡、心衰住院、缺血性卒中、短暂性脑缺血发作、心肌梗死和系统性血栓栓塞。采用多变量调整模型及扩展Cox模型（考虑非比例风险）分析。
AI.result: LAAT检出率AF组14.2%、AFL组10.2%（p=0.29）；多变量调整后AFL vs AF与LAAT无独立关联（aOR 0.53，95%CI 0.25-1.11，p=0.09）。中位随访6.85年（3.64-8.53），心血管死亡96例（14.6%；AF 78例，AFL 18例），心衰住院91例（13.9%；AF 78例，AFL 13例）。Log-rank检验无统计学差异（心血管死亡p=0.42，心衰住院p=0.73）。扩展Cox模型显示AFL vs AF与心血管死亡（aHR 1.09，95%CI 0.64-1.85，p=0.75）及心衰住院（aHR 0.69，95%CI 0.37-1.27，p=0.23）无独立关联。AFL组导管消融比例83.7% vs AF组24.6%，其中指数住院期间消融分别为46.9% vs 0%。
AI.conclusion: 在此符合抗凝指征、接受TEE指导节律控制的选定队列中，初始心律失常类型（AF vs AFL）与LAAT、心血管死亡或心衰住院无显著独立关联。但两组后续节律控制治疗路径差异显著，且AFL样本量小、置信区间宽，不能排除临床有意义的差异。结果不应外推至未选择的AF/AFL人群（如无症状、仅室率控制或未抗凝者），且比较基于就诊时心律失常，未系统确认随访期间节律表型。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：在调整基线心血管特征后，心房颤动（AF）患者与心房扑动（AFL）患者的长期预后是否存在差异仍不明确。方法：在这项前瞻性观察性队列研究中，我们纳入了656例符合预设抗凝入选标准、计划接受节律控制干预前进行经食管超声心动图（TEE）检查的AF（n = 558）或AFL（n = 98）患者。主要终点为基线TEE检出的左心耳血栓（LAAT）。长期结局包括心血管死亡、心力衰竭（HF）住院、缺血性卒中、短暂性脑缺血发作、心肌梗死和系统性血栓栓塞。结果：AF患者中LAAT检出率为14.2%，AFL患者为10.2%（p = 0.29）。多变量调整后，AFL与AF相比并非LAAT的独立相关因素（调整比值比[aOR]，0.53；95%置信区间[CI]，0.25-1.11；p = 0.09）。中位随访时间为6.85（3.64-8.53）年。96例患者发生心血管死亡（14.6%；AF：n = 78，AFL：n = 18），91例患者发生HF住院（13.9%；AF：n = 78，AFL：n = 13）。心血管死亡（log-rank p = 0.42）和HF住院（log-rank p = 0.73）的log-rank比较均无统计学显著性。在考虑非比例风险的扩展Cox模型中，AFL与AF相比并非心血管死亡（调整风险比[aHR]，1.09；95% CI，0.64-1.85；p = 0.75）或HF住院（aHR，0.69；95% CI，0.37-1.27；p = 0.23）的独立相关因素。结论：AFL患者中记录到导管消融的比例为83.7%，AF患者为24.6%，其中住院期间消融分别为46.9%和0%。在这个符合预设抗凝入选标准、因TEE指导的节律控制而转诊的选择性队列中，未检测到基线心律失常类型（AF vs. AFL）与LAAT、心血管死亡或HF住院之间存在统计学显著的独立关联。重要的是，这些发现描述的是在后续节律控制治疗路径显著不同的情况下的关联，并不能确立AF和AFL具有等同的内在风险。AFL组样本量较小（n = 98）且置信区间较宽限制了精确性；不能排除具有临床意义的差异。这些发现不应外推至未经选择的AF/AFL人群，包括无症状患者、仅接受心率控制治疗的患者或未接受抗凝治疗的患者。比较基于就诊时的心律失常，而非确认在整个随访期间持续存在的节律表型；最初表现为AFL的患者中新发AF未被系统确认。

title: Systemic Inflammation and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Acute Coronary Syndromes: A Single-Center Cohort Study.
summary: Background/Objectives: New-onset atrial fibrillation (NOAF) is a common complication of acute coronary syndrome (ACS) and is associated with adverse clinical outcomes. Although systemic inflammation has been implicated in the pathogenesis of NOAF, the contribution of different inflammatory biomarkers and their incremental value beyond established clinical factors remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to examine the association between inflammatory biomarkers and NOAF in patients hospitalized with ACS and to assess their contribution beyond established clinical risk factors. Materials and Methods: This prospective single-center cohort included 100 consecutive patients hospitalized with ACS and without a documented history of atrial fibrillation. Comprehensive demographic, clinical, laboratory, echocardiographic, and angiographic data were collected. Systemic inflammatory status was assessed using C-reactive protein (CRP), the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), the monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR), and the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII). Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with NOAF. The incremental contribution of inflammatory biomarkers to apparent in-sample model discrimination was explored using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis and DeLong's test. Sensitivity analyses were performed according to the timing of NOAF occurrence. Results: NOAF occurred in 33 of 100 patients (33%) during hospitalization. Patients who developed NOAF were older and exhibited greater left atrial enlargement, more extensive coronary artery disease, and higher inflammatory biomarker levels. In univariable analyses, CRP, NLR, and SII were significantly associated with NOAF. In exploratory multivariable analyses adjusted for clinically selected covariates, CRP remained associated with NOAF (adjusted OR 1.71, 95% CI 1.08-2.91; p = 0.031), whereas NLR, SII, NT-proBNP, and troponin did not retain statistically significant associations. CRP demonstrated the highest numerical improvement in model discrimination, although the increase in AUC compared with the baseline clinical model was not statistically significant. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the consistency of the association between CRP and NOAF. Conclusions: In this exploratory single-center cohort, CRP remained associated with NOAF after adjustment for clinically selected covariates, supporting further investigation of the relationship between systemic inflammation and NOAF development. These findings require confirmation in larger cohorts with internal and external validation.

AI.tldr: 在100例ACS住院患者中，33%发生新发房颤；校正临床因素后仅CRP与NOAF独立相关（aOR 1.71），但模型判别力提升无统计学意义。
AI.motivation: 新发房颤（NOAF）是急性冠脉综合征（ACS）常见并发症且与不良预后相关，系统性炎症被认为参与其发生，但不同炎症标志物（CRP、NLR、MLR、SII）的独立贡献及其在既有临床危险因素之外的增量价值尚不清楚。
AI.method: 前瞻性单中心队列研究，连续纳入100例住院ACS且无房颤病史的患者，收集人口学、临床、实验室、超声心动图及冠脉造影资料；以CRP、NLR、MLR、SII评估系统性炎症状态；终点为住院期间NOAF；采用单因素及多因素logistic回归分析相关因素，并以ROC曲线及DeLong检验探讨炎症标志物对模型判别力的增量贡献，另按NOAF发生时间行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 住院期间33例（33%）发生NOAF。NOAF患者年龄更大、左房扩大更明显、冠脉病变更广泛、炎症标志物水平更高。单因素分析中CRP、NLR、SII均与NOAF显著相关；在校正临床选定协变量的探索性多因素分析中，仅CRP仍与NOAF相关（校正OR 1.71，95%CI 1.08-2.91，P=0.031），NLR、SII、NT-proBNP及肌钙蛋白未保持统计学显著关联。CRP对模型判别力的数值改善最大，但较基线临床模型的AUC提升无统计学意义。敏感性分析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 在这一探索性单中心队列中，校正临床选定协变量后CRP仍与ACS患者NOAF相关，支持进一步研究系统性炎症与NOAF发生的关系；但炎症标志物未显示显著的增量判别价值，结论需在更大样本中经内部及外部验证确认，目前尚不足以改变电生理临床实践。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：新发心房颤动（NOAF）是急性冠脉综合征（ACS）的常见并发症，并与不良临床结局相关。尽管系统性炎症已被认为参与NOAF的发病机制，但不同炎症生物标志物的作用及其在既定临床因素之外的增量价值仍未被完全理解。本研究旨在探讨因ACS住院的患者中炎症生物标志物与NOAF之间的关联，并评估其在既定临床危险因素之外的贡献。材料与方法：这项前瞻性单中心队列连续纳入了100例因ACS住院且无房颤病史记录的患者。收集了全面的人口学、临床、实验室、超声心动图和血管造影数据。使用C反应蛋白（CRP）、中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR）、单核细胞与淋巴细胞比值（MLR）和系统性免疫炎症指数（SII）评估系统性炎症状态。进行单变量和多变量logistic回归分析以识别与NOAF相关的因素。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析和DeLong检验探讨炎症生物标志物对表观样本内模型区分度的增量贡献。根据NOAF发生时间进行敏感性分析。结果：100例患者中有33例（33%）在住院期间发生NOAF。发生NOAF的患者年龄更大，表现出更明显的左心房扩大、更广泛的冠状动脉疾病和更高的炎症生物标志物水平。在单变量分析中，CRP、NLR和SII与NOAF显著相关。在调整临床选定协变量的探索性多变量分析中，CRP仍与NOAF相关（调整OR 1.71，95% CI 1.08-2.91；p = 0.031），而NLR、SII、NT-proBNP和肌钙蛋白未保持统计学显著关联。CRP在模型区分度上显示出最高的数值改善，尽管与基线临床模型相比AUC的增加无统计学显著性。敏感性分析证实了CRP与NOAF关联的一致性。结论：在这个探索性单中心队列中，调整临床选定协变量后，CRP仍与NOAF相关，支持进一步研究系统性炎症与NOAF发生之间的关系。这些发现需要在具有内部和外部验证的更大队列中确认。

title: Serum Troponin and Procedural Duration Predict Delayed iASD Closure After Left Atrial Arrhythmia Ablation.
summary: Background: Transseptal puncture is routinely performed to access the left atrium during catheter ablation of left atrial tachyarrhythmias. Although iatrogenic atrial septal defects (iASDs) frequently occur after the procedure, factors influencing delayed defect closure remain incompletely understood. Myocardial injury induced by radiofrequency (RF) ablation results in the release of cardiac troponin into the circulation and may reflect the extent of procedural tissue injury. Methods: This prospective study included patients who underwent RF ablation for left atrial arrhythmias at the Iraqi Center for Heart Diseases in collaboration with the College of medicine, University of Baghdad between March 2023 and April 2024. Serum troponin concentrations, procedural duration, and echocardiographic assessment of iASD size were evaluated prospectively to determine their association with delayed atrial septal defect closure over a period of 3-6 months. Results: Forty-seven patients were enrolled (mean age, 36.28 ± 10.34 years; 48.9% male). A significant positive association was observed between iASD size and serum troponin level (p < 0.001). For each unit increase in post-procedure troponin, the likelihood of ASD presence increases by more than two-fold at 3-6 months. Larger septal defects were also associated with longer procedural duration. Conclusions: Elevated serum troponin concentration following RF ablation is associated with larger iatrogenic atrial septal defects and may serve as a useful predictor of delayed iASD closure during the first six months of follow-up.

AI.tldr: 射频消融术后血清肌钙蛋白升高与医源性房间隔缺损增大及6个月内延迟闭合相关，每单位升高使缺损存在风险增加两倍以上。
AI.motivation: 房间隔穿刺是左房心律失常消融的常规步骤，术后医源性房间隔缺损（iASD）常见，但影响其延迟闭合的因素尚不明确。射频消融导致的心肌损伤释放肌钙蛋白，可能反映手术组织损伤程度，本研究旨在探讨其与iASD延迟闭合的关系。
AI.method: 前瞻性研究，纳入2023年3月至2024年4月在伊拉克心脏病中心接受射频消融的左房心律失常患者47例（平均年龄36.28±10.34岁，男性48.9%）。评估术后血清肌钙蛋白浓度、手术时长及超声心动图测量的iASD大小，随访3-6个月，分析其与iASD延迟闭合的关联。
AI.result: iASD大小与血清肌钙蛋白水平呈显著正相关（p<0.001）。术后肌钙蛋白每升高一个单位，3-6个月时ASD存在的可能性增加两倍以上。较大的间隔缺损也与更长的手术时长相关。
AI.conclusion: 射频消融术后血清肌钙蛋白升高与较大的iASD相关，可能作为随访前6个月iASD延迟闭合的有用预测指标。这提示监测术后肌钙蛋白有助于识别高风险的iASD患者，但研究样本量小且为单中心，结论需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 背景：经房间隔穿刺是左房房性心动过速导管消融中常规用于进入左心房的步骤。尽管医源性房间隔缺损（iASD）在术后经常发生，但影响缺损延迟闭合的因素仍不完全清楚。射频（RF）消融引起的心肌损伤导致心肌肌钙蛋白释放入循环，可能反映手术组织损伤的程度。方法：本前瞻性研究纳入2023年3月至2024年4月期间在伊拉克心脏病中心与巴格达大学医学院合作接受左房心律失常RF消融的患者。前瞻性评估血清肌钙蛋白浓度、手术时长和超声心动图评估的iASD大小，以确定其与3-6个月期间房间隔缺损延迟闭合的关联。结果：共纳入47例患者（平均年龄36.28 ± 10.34岁；48.9%为男性）。观察到iASD大小与血清肌钙蛋白水平之间存在显著正相关（p < 0.001）。术后肌钙蛋白每增加一个单位，3-6个月时ASD存在的可能性增加两倍以上。较大的间隔缺损也与较长的手术时长相关。结论：RF消融后血清肌钙蛋白浓度升高与较大的医源性房间隔缺损相关，并可能作为随访前六个月内iASD延迟闭合的有用预测指标。

title: Apixaban Benefit in Subclinical Atrial Fibrillation Accounting for Competing Risks: A Reanalysis of the ARTESIA Trial.
summary: In the ARTESIA trial, apixaban reduced stroke and systemic embolism compared with aspirin in patients with subclinical atrial fibrillation (AF), but the primary analysis treated death and AF progression as censoring rather than competing events. We estimated the absolute risk reduction (ARR) at 3.5 years treating death and AF progression as competing events. We used event-level data reconstructed from published Kaplan-Meier curves to probabilistically impute status and timing of competing events. The ARR was 1.94% when treating death and AF progression as censoring events vs. 1.62% treating them as competing events (difference 0.33 percentage points; 95% CI 0.04 to 0.62). Absolute benefit estimates depend on how competing events are handled. Competing risk analyses can provide more realistic estimates of expected therapeutic benefit at the point of treatment decisions when competing events are common.

AI.tldr: ARTESIA 再分析显示，将死亡与房颤进展按竞争风险处理时，阿哌沙班在亚临床房颤中 3.5 年绝对风险降低为 1.62%，低于传统删失法的 1.94%。
AI.motivation: ARTESIA 试验已证实阿哌沙班较阿司匹林可减少亚临床房颤患者的卒中与系统性栓塞，但其主要分析将死亡和房颤进展作为删失处理，而非竞争事件，可能高估绝对获益；临床决策更关注竞争事件常见时的真实绝对获益。
AI.method: 基于 ARTESIA 试验的再分析，利用已发表 Kaplan-Meier 曲线重建事件级数据，对竞争事件的状态与发生时间进行概率性插补，分别以删失和竞争风险两种方式估算 3.5 年绝对风险降低（ARR），并计算两者差值及 95% CI。
AI.result: 3.5 年 ARR 在将死亡与房颤进展作为删失事件时为 1.94%，作为竞争事件时为 1.62%，差值为 0.33 个百分点（95% CI 0.04 至 0.62）。
AI.conclusion: 绝对获益估计取决于竞争事件的处理方式；在竞争事件常见时，竞争风险分析可提供更贴近治疗决策时点的预期获益估计，提示解读亚临床房颤抗凝证据时应考虑该方法学影响；本研究为基于重建数据的再分析，结论需谨慎外推。

summary_zh: 在ARTESIA试验中，与阿司匹林相比，阿哌沙班减少了亚临床心房颤动（AF）患者的卒中和系统性栓塞，但主要分析将死亡和AF进展视为删失事件而非竞争事件。我们将死亡和AF进展作为竞争事件，估算了3.5年时的绝对风险降低（ARR）。我们使用从已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线重建的事件水平数据，对竞争事件的状态和时间进行概率性插补。将死亡和AF进展视为删失事件时，ARR为1.94%；将其视为竞争事件时，ARR为1.62%（差异0.33个百分点；95% CI 0.04至0.62）。绝对获益估计取决于竞争事件的处理方式。当竞争事件常见时，竞争风险分析可以在治疗决策点提供更现实的预期治疗获益估计。

title: Impaired Left Atrial Contractile Strain and Late Pacemaker Implantation After the Cox-Maze Procedure Despite Maintained Sinus Rhythm.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Late bradyarrhythmia requiring permanent pacemaker implantation remains a challenge after the Cox-Maze procedure. We evaluated whether left atrial contractile strain at 1 year predicts late pacemaker implantation in patients with normal sinus rhythm.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 259 patients who underwent the Maze procedure between 2012 and 2024 and maintained normal sinus rhythm at 1 year. Left atrial contractile strain was assessed using two-dimensional speckle-tracking echocardiography.

RESULTS: Of 329 patients screened, 50 were excluded for atrial fibrillation recurrence at 1 year (1-year freedom from atrial fibrillation, 83.8%). During follow-up (median 58 months), 22 patients required pacemaker implantation. The optimal strain cutoff was -1.8% (area under the curve 0.658), and patients with impaired left atrial function (strain ≥ -1.8%) had a higher incidence of pacemaker implantation (log-rank P < 0.001). Impaired left atrial contractile strain (hazard ratio 3.99; 95% confidence interval, 1.41-11.35), fine fibrillatory waves (3.64; 1.32-10.01), and increased preoperative left atrial volume (1.004 per mL; 1.001-1.008) were independent predictors, and a combined model improved predictive accuracy (area under the curve 0.782). The excess risk was concentrated within the first 5 years after surgery (hazard ratio 8.47 versus 2.22 thereafter).

CONCLUSIONS: Impaired left atrial contractile strain 1 year after the Cox-Maze procedure independently predicts late pacemaker implantation despite stable normal sinus rhythm, particularly within the first 5 years, highlighting a dissociation between electrical and functional recovery. It may serve as a surrogate for atrial fibrosis and latent conduction disturbance, warranting intensified surveillance in high-risk patients during this period.

AI.tldr: Cox-Maze术后1年虽维持窦性心律，但左房收缩应变受损（≥-1.8%）独立预测晚期起搏器植入，风险集中术后5年内。
AI.motivation: Cox-Maze术后晚期需永久起搏器植入的缓慢性心律失常仍是临床难题，即使维持正常窦性心律，既往缺乏预测指标。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2012-2024年259例Cox-Maze术后1年维持窦性心律患者，用二维斑点追踪超声评估左房收缩应变，终点为晚期起搏器植入，采用Cox回归和ROC分析。
AI.result: 中位随访58个月，22例（8.5%）需起搏器。最佳应变截断值-1.8%（AUC 0.658），受损组起搏器植入率更高（log-rank P<0.001）。独立预测因素：应变受损（HR 3.99；95%CI 1.41-11.35）、细颤波（HR 3.64；95%CI 1.32-10.01）、术前左房容积增大（每mL HR 1.004；95%CI 1.001-1.008）。联合模型AUC 0.782。术后5年内HR 8.47，之后HR 2.22。
AI.conclusion: Cox-Maze术后1年左房收缩应变受损独立预测晚期起搏器植入，提示电与功能恢复分离，可能反映心房纤维化及潜在传导障碍，术后5年内高危患者需加强监测。

summary_zh:
背景：Cox-Maze 手术后需要植入永久起搏器的晚期缓慢性心律失常仍是一项挑战。我们评估了 1 年时左心房收缩期应变是否能预测窦性心律正常患者的晚期起搏器植入。

方法：我们回顾性分析了 2012 年至 2024 年间接受 Maze 手术并在 1 年时维持正常窦性心律的 259 例患者。使用二维斑点追踪超声心动图评估左心房收缩期应变。

结果：在筛查的 329 例患者中，50 例因 1 年时房颤复发被排除（1 年无房颤率为 83.8%）。随访期间（中位 58 个月），22 例患者需要植入起搏器。最佳应变截断值为 -1.8%（曲线下面积 0.658），左心房功能受损（应变 ≥ -1.8%）的患者起搏器植入发生率更高（log-rank P < 0.001）。左心房收缩期应变受损（风险比 3.99；95% 置信区间 1.41-11.35）、细颤波（3.64；1.32-10.01）和术前左心房容积增加（每 mL 1.004；1.001-1.008）是独立预测因素，联合模型提高了预测准确性（曲线下面积 0.782）。超额风险集中在术后前 5 年内（风险比 8.47，此后为 2.22）。

结论：Cox-Maze 手术后 1 年左心房收缩期应变受损独立预测晚期起搏器植入，尽管正常窦性心律稳定，尤其是在前 5 年内，突显了电学与功能恢复之间的分离。它可能作为心房纤维化和潜在传导障碍的替代指标，值得在此期间对高风险患者加强监测。

title: Weekly Journal Scan: Less-than-OPTIMAl evidence for a shorter duration of dual antithrombotic therapy after percutaneous coronary intervention in patients with atrial fibrillation.
Efficacy and safety of posterior wall isolation in persistent atrial fibrillation is modified by ablation energy source.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Posterior wall isolation (PWI) is a common adjunct to pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in catheter ablation of persistent atrial fibrillation (AF), yet randomized data have been discordant. Prior syntheses have pooled studies across ablation energy sources, which may obscure energy-specific effects. We examined whether the association of PWI with arrhythmia recurrence in persistent AF is modified by ablation energy source.

METHODS: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, and Web of Science for studies comparing PWI plus PVI with PVI alone in persistent AF. The primary endpoint was recurrence of all atrial tachyarrhythmias; secondary endpoints were recurrence of AF alone, procedural time, and procedural complications. Studies were stratified a priori by energy source (cryoballoon, radiofrequency [RF], and pulsed field [PF]). Odds ratios (OR) and mean differences were pooled using random-effects models, with subgroup differences assessed by the test for interaction.

RESULTS: Twenty-two studies with 4400 patients with persistent AF (2029 PWI and PVI, 2371 PVI alone) were included. Compared with PVI alone, PWI was associated with reduced recurrence of all atrial tachyarrhythmias overall (OR 0.54, 95% CI 0.40-0.73), but the effect differed by energy source (test for subgroup differences p = 0.0006): cryoballoon OR 0.34 (95% CI 0.26-0.43), RF OR 0.67 (95% CI 0.43-1.04), and PF OR 0.96 (95% CI 0.55-1.70). A concordant pattern was observed for recurrence of AF alone (overall OR 0.36, 95% CI 0.25-0.51). PWI was associated with longer procedural times, with a graded effect across energies (cryoballoon mean difference 51.1 min; p = 0.007 for subgroup differences). Procedural complications did not differ between groups overall (OR 1.29, 95% CI 0.92-1.82) or by energy source (p = 0.49).

CONCLUSIONS: In persistent AF, the association of PWI with freedom from atrial arrhythmia was concentrated in cryoballoon-based ablation and was not evident with RF or PF, without an excess of complications. These findings suggest that the conflicting literature on PWI may be explained, in part, by differences in ablation energy source rather than by the anatomic target alone. Because energy source is partly confounded with study design and the cryoballoon evidence rests on few randomized trials, this association is hypothesis-generating and merits evaluation in energy-specific randomized trials. No benefit was observed in the pulsed field ablation stratum, the modality in which adjunctive PWI is now most commonly performed, so its routine use may not confer the benefit reported with earlier energy sources.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤中，后壁隔离（PWI）联合肺静脉隔离（PVI）减少心律失常复发的获益主要集中于冷冻球囊消融，射频和脉冲场消融未见明确获益，且不增加并发症。
AI.motivation: PWI是持续性房颤导管消融中PVI的常用辅助策略，但随机对照研究结果不一致。既往荟萃分析将不同消融能量来源的研究合并，可能掩盖能量来源的特异性效应。本研究旨在探讨PWI与心律失常复发的关联是否受消融能量来源影响。
AI.method: 系统检索Ovid MEDLINE、Embase和Web of Science，纳入比较持续性房颤患者PWI+PVI与单纯PVI的研究。主要终点为所有房性快速性心律失常复发；次要终点为单纯房颤复发、手术时间和手术并发症。研究按能量来源（冷冻球囊、射频、脉冲场）预先分层，采用随机效应模型合并比值比（OR）和均数差，通过交互作用检验评估亚组差异。
AI.result: 共纳入22项研究、4400例持续性房颤患者（PWI+PVI组2029例，单纯PVI组2371例）。与单纯PVI相比，PWI总体与所有房性快速性心律失常复发减少相关（OR 0.54，95% CI 0.40-0.73），但效应因能量来源而异（亚组差异检验P=0.0006）：冷冻球囊OR 0.34（95% CI 0.26-0.43），射频OR 0.67（95% CI 0.43-1.04），脉冲场OR 0.96（95% CI 0.55-1.70）。单纯房颤复发呈一致模式（总体OR 0.36，95% CI 0.25-0.51）。PWI与手术时间延长相关，且不同能量间呈梯度效应（冷冻球囊均数差51.1分钟；亚组差异P=0.007）。手术并发症总体无差异（OR 1.29，95% CI 0.92-1.82），按能量来源亦无差异（P=0.49）。
AI.conclusion: 在持续性房颤中，PWI与无房性心律失常的关联集中于冷冻球囊消融，射频和脉冲场消融未见明确获益，且不增加并发症。这些发现提示PWI文献的矛盾部分可由消融能量来源差异解释，而非仅由解剖靶点决定。由于能量来源与研究设计部分混杂且冷冻球囊证据基于少数随机试验，该关联为假设生成性，需在能量特异性随机试验中验证。脉冲场消融亚组未见获益，而该模态目前最常进行辅助性PWI，其常规使用可能不带来早期能量来源所报告的获益。

summary_zh:
背景：后壁隔离（PWI）是持续性心房颤动（AF）导管消融中肺静脉隔离（PVI）的常见辅助手段，然而随机数据并不一致。既往的汇总分析将不同消融能量来源的研究合并在一起，这可能掩盖了能量来源特异性的效应。我们检验了在持续性AF中，PWI与心律失常复发之间的关联是否受到消融能量来源的修饰。

方法：我们检索了Ovid MEDLINE、Embase和Web of Science，寻找在持续性AF中比较PWI联合PVI与单纯PVI的研究。主要终点为所有房性快速性心律失常的复发；次要终点为单纯AF复发、手术时间和手术并发症。研究预先按能量来源（冷冻球囊、射频[RF]和脉冲场[PF]）进行分层。采用随机效应模型汇总比值比（OR）和均数差，亚组差异通过交互作用检验进行评估。

结果：共纳入22项研究，包含4400例持续性AF患者（2029例接受PWI联合PVI，2371例接受单纯PVI）。与单纯PVI相比，PWI总体上与所有房性快速性心律失常复发减少相关（OR 0.54，95% CI 0.40-0.73），但效应因能量来源而异（亚组差异检验p = 0.0006）：冷冻球囊OR 0.34（95% CI 0.26-0.43），RF OR 0.67（95% CI 0.43-1.04），PF OR 0.96（95% CI 0.55-1.70）。对于单纯AF复发也观察到一致的模式（总体OR 0.36，95% CI 0.25-0.51）。PWI与更长的手术时间相关，且在不同能量间呈现梯度效应（冷冻球囊均数差51.1分钟；亚组差异p = 0.007）。手术并发症在总体组间（OR 1.29，95% CI 0.92-1.82）或按能量来源分层（p = 0.49）均无差异。

结论：在持续性AF中，PWI与无房性心律失常的关联集中在基于冷冻球囊的消融中，而在RF或PF中不明显，且不增加并发症。这些发现提示，关于PWI的文献结论相互矛盾，部分原因可能在于消融能量来源的差异，而非仅在于解剖靶点本身。由于能量来源与研究设计存在部分混杂，且冷冻球囊证据基于少数随机试验，这一关联属于假设生成性，值得在能量来源特异性的随机试验中评估。在脉冲场消融分层中未观察到获益，而该 modality 正是目前最常进行辅助性PWI的方式，因此其常规使用可能无法带来早期能量来源所报告的获益。

title: Feasibility Assessment of Smartphone Camera-Based Atrial Fibrillation Detection Compared With Portable Electrocardiogram: Single-Patient Case Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) affects more than 33 million people globally, with many cases remaining undiagnosed due to the paroxysmal nature of the condition. Current portable AF detection devices require additional hardware, and their cost may limit their accessibility in community screening programs. Facial camera-based remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is a novel alternative to conventional fingertip-based photoplethysmography (PPG) that enables contact-free cardiac rhythm assessment.

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the technical feasibility of a novel smartphone camera-based facial rPPG AF detection system by comparing its performance with that of a portable electrocardiogram (ECG) device under real-world home monitoring conditions.

METHODS: We conducted a prospective, single-patient volunteer case study involving a patient with diagnosed paroxysmal AF and atrial flutter with variable block over 12 consecutive days. Simultaneous 60-second recordings were scheduled 3 times daily using the electronRx smartphone app and a Kardia portable ECG device to obtain a total of 36 paired recordings. The primary outcome was device agreement in rhythm classification between the 2 systems. Secondary outcomes included assessment of the effect of signal quality on device agreement and analysis of discordant recordings to identify technical limitations.

RESULTS: Of the 36 scheduled recording sessions, 35 were attempted, yielding 24 successful simultaneous recordings. Of these, 23 paired recordings met the quality criteria, and device agreement was achieved in 21 (91.3%) recordings. The smartphone system detected 4 of the 5 episodes classified as AF by the Kardia device and agreed with 17 of the 18 recordings classified as normal sinus rhythm. A total of 2 discordant cases were identified: 1 false negative associated with atrial flutter presenting as a fixed 3:1 atrioventricular block and 1 false positive related to poor signal quality due to suboptimal lighting conditions. Signal quality significantly affected performance, with 94.7% agreement in recordings of good quality compared with 75% in recordings of poor quality.

CONCLUSIONS: This case study demonstrates the technical feasibility of using a smartphone facial camera-based rPPG rhythm analysis for AF detection. The approach shows promise as an accessible screening tool. However, the single-patient design, data attrition resulting from synchronization and signal quality issues, and the identified technical limitations highlight the need for larger validation studies before clinical application can be considered.

AI.tldr: 单例阵发性房颤患者的12天家庭监测中，智能手机面部摄像头rPPG与便携式ECG的节律分类一致率为91.3%（21/23），提示该无接触筛查技术可行但需更大样本验证。
AI.motivation: 房颤全球患病人数超过3300万，因阵发性特点大量病例未被诊断；现有便携式房颤检测设备需额外硬件、成本较高，限制其在社区筛查中的可及性。基于面部摄像头的远程光电容积描记（rPPG）可实现无接触节律评估，但其与便携式ECG在真实家庭环境下的同步对比证据尚缺。
AI.method: 前瞻性单患者志愿者病例研究，纳入1例确诊阵发性房颤并伴可变传导比例心房扑动的患者，连续12天、每日3次计划同步进行60秒记录，使用electronRx智能手机应用与Kardia便携式ECG，共计划36组配对记录。主要终点为两系统节律分类的一致性；次要终点为信号质量对一致性的影响及对不一致记录的技术局限分析。
AI.result: 36次计划记录中实际尝试35次，获得24组成功同步记录，其中23组符合质量要求；21组（91.3%）节律分类一致。智能手机系统识别出Kardia判定的5次房颤发作中的4次，并在18组正常窦性心律记录中一致17组。共2组不一致：1例假阴性对应心房扑动呈固定3:1房室传导，1例假阳性与光照不佳导致的信号质量差相关。信号质量显著影响表现，质量良好记录一致率94.7%，质量差记录为75%。
AI.conclusion: 本单例研究提示智能手机面部摄像头rPPG节律分析用于房颤检测在技术上可行，有望成为易获取的筛查工具；但单患者设计、同步与信号质量导致的数据脱落以及已识别的技术局限（如固定比例传导的心房扑动漏检、光照依赖）表明，在临床推广前仍需更大规模的验证研究。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）影响全球超过3300万人，由于该疾病的阵发性特征，许多病例仍未得到诊断。当前的可携带AF检测设备需要额外的硬件，其成本可能限制其在社区筛查项目中的可及性。基于面部摄像头的远程光电容积脉搏波描记法（rPPG）是传统基于指尖的光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）的一种新颖替代方案，可实现无接触的心律评估。

目的：本研究旨在通过比较一种新型智能手机摄像头面部rPPG AF检测系统与便携式心电图（ECG）设备在真实家庭监测条件下的性能，评估该系统的技术可行性。

方法：我们进行了一项前瞻性、单患者志愿者病例研究，涉及一名确诊为阵发性AF和可变传导阻滞的心房扑动患者，持续12天。使用electronRx智能手机应用程序和Kardia便携式ECG设备每天安排3次同步60秒记录，共获得36对配对记录。主要结局是两种系统在心律分类上的设备一致性。次要结局包括评估信号质量对设备一致性的影响，以及分析不一致记录以识别技术局限性。

结果：在36次计划记录会话中，尝试了35次，获得24次成功的同步记录。其中，23对配对记录符合质量标准，21次（91.3%）记录达到设备一致性。智能手机系统检测到Kardia设备分类为AF的5次发作中的4次，并与分类为正常窦性心律的18次记录中的17次一致。共识别出2例不一致病例：1例假阴性，与表现为固定3:1房室传导阻滞的心房扑动相关；1例假阳性，与因光照条件欠佳导致的信号质量差相关。信号质量显著影响性能，质量良好的记录一致性为94.7%，而质量差的记录一致性为75%。

结论：本病例研究证明了使用基于智能手机面部摄像头的rPPG心律分析进行AF检测的技术可行性。该方法显示出作为可及筛查工具的潜力。然而，单患者设计、因同步和信号质量问题导致的数据丢失，以及已识别的技术局限性，均强调在考虑临床应用之前需要进行更大规模的验证研究。

title: Incidence and predictors of de novo atrial fibrillation in patients with heart failure undergoing continuous rhythm monitoring.
summary:
INTRODUCTION AND OBJECTIVES: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is associated with adverse clinical outcomes in patients with heart failure (HF). The true incidence of de novo AF in HF, however, remains uncertain. Moreover, the role of clinical variables and circulating biomarkers in AF risk stratification in this population is not well established. This study aimed to determine the incidence of AF in patients with HF using long-term continuous rhythm monitoring and to identify clinical, structural, and biomarker-based predictors.

METHODS: This multicenter, prospective study included patients with HF and reduced or preserved left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF). Long-term rhythm monitoring was performed using implantable loop recorders or single-chamber defibrillators without atrial leads and with ventricular pacing < 20%. Serial blood samples were obtained at baseline, during follow-up, and during HF decompensation, and analyzed using a multiplex panel of selected biomarkers. Multivariable analyses were performed using both baseline biomarker levels and laboratory values closest to AF onset or HF decompensation.

RESULTS: A total of 345 patients were enrolled (79% male; median age 68 years; 53% with LVEF< 40%. During a median follow-up of 756 days, 86 patients (24.9%) developed AF episodes lasting > 6 minutes, and 64 patients (18.5%) died. Hypertension, left atrial volume, beta-blocker use, CA-125, NT-proBNP, COL4A1, and AT1-AA were independently associated with AF, whereas aldosterone receptor antagonist therapy was associated with a lower risk of HF (C-index, 0.74). Patients with persistent AF as the initial manifestation had significantly higher mortality than those with paroxysmal AF or no AF. NT-proBNP and COL4A1 were associated with mortality. Clinically relevant bradyarrhythmias and ventricular tachyarrhythmias were also detected.

CONCLUSION: De novo AF is a common complication in patients with HF. Integrating clinical variables, structural parameters, and biomarkers improves the identification of patients at increased risk of developing AF. Continuous monitoring enables early detection of rhythm abnormalities that may influence therapeutic management.

AI.tldr: 在345例心衰患者中，长期连续心律监测显示新发房颤（>6分钟）发生率达24.9%，以持续性房颤为首发表现者死亡率显著更高，临床+结构+生物标志物联合模型可识别高危患者。
AI.motivation: 房颤与心衰患者不良预后相关，但心衰人群新发房颤的真实发生率尚不明确，临床变量与循环生物标志物在该人群房颤风险分层中的作用亦未确立，本研究旨在通过长期连续心律监测明确发生率并识别预测因素。
AI.method: 多中心前瞻性研究，纳入345例射血分数降低或保留的心衰患者（79%男性，中位年龄68岁，53% LVEF<40%）。采用植入式循环记录仪或无心房导线的单腔除颤器（心室起搏<20%）进行长期心律监测，基线与随访期及心衰失代偿时采集血样，用多重panel检测生物标志物。采用基线及最接近房颤发作/失代偿时的实验室值进行多变量分析。
AI.result: 中位随访756天，86例（24.9%）出现持续>6分钟的房颤发作，64例（18.5%）死亡。高血压、左房容积、β受体阻滞剂使用、CA-125、NT-proBNP、COL4A1及AT1-AA与房颤独立相关，醛固酮受体拮抗剂治疗与较低心衰风险相关（C-index 0.74）。以持续性房颤为首发表现者死亡率显著高于阵发性房颤或无房颤者；NT-proBNP与COL4A1与死亡相关。另检出临床相关的缓慢性心律失常与室性快速性心律失常。
AI.conclusion: 新发房颤是心衰患者常见并发症，整合临床变量、结构参数与生物标志物可改善房颤高危患者识别；连续监测有助于早期发现可能影响治疗决策的心律异常。局限性：摘要未报告各预测因素的效应量、95%CI及P值，单腔装置无法记录心房电图，结果外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
引言与目的：心房颤动（AF）与心力衰竭（HF）患者的不良临床结局相关。然而，HF中新发AF的真实发病率仍不确定。此外，临床变量和循环生物标志物在该人群AF风险分层中的作用尚未明确。本研究旨在通过长期连续心律监测确定HF患者AF的发病率，并识别临床、结构和基于生物标志物的预测因素。

方法：这项多中心、前瞻性研究纳入了左心室射血分数（LVEF）降低或保留的HF患者。使用植入式循环记录仪或无心房导线且心室起搏<20%的单腔除颤器进行长期心律监测。在基线、随访期间和HF失代偿期间获取系列血样，并使用选定的生物标志物多重面板进行分析。多变量分析使用基线生物标志物水平和最接近AF发作或HF失代偿的实验室值进行。

结果：共纳入345例患者（79%男性；中位年龄68岁；53% LVEF<40%）。在中位随访756天期间，86例患者（24.9%）出现持续>6分钟的AF发作，64例患者（18.5%）死亡。高血压、左心房容积、β受体阻滞剂使用、CA-125、NT-proBNP、COL4A1和AT1-AA与AF独立相关，而醛固酮受体拮抗剂治疗与较低的HF风险相关（C指数0.74）。以持续性AF为首发表现的患者死亡率显著高于阵发性AF或无AF的患者。NT-proBNP和COL4A1与死亡率相关。还检测到临床相关的缓慢性心律失常和室性快速性心律失常。

结论：新发AF是HF患者常见的并发症。整合临床变量、结构参数和生物标志物可改善对AF发生风险增加患者的识别。连续监测能够早期发现可能影响治疗管理的心律异常。

title: Fulminant Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Associated Myocarditis Presenting with Complete Atrioventricular Block After Combined Nivolumab and Ipilimumab Therapy: An Autopsy-Confirmed Case Report.
summary: Background: Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-associated myocarditis is a rare but potentially fatal immune-related adverse event that may present with conduction abnormalities, ventricular arrhythmias, cardiogenic shock, and sudden cardiac death. The risk is increased with combined programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) and cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated protein 4 (CTLA-4) blockade. We report a fatal case of fulminant ICI-associated myocarditis following combined nivolumab and ipilimumab therapy. Case Presentation: A 79-year-old man with metastatic clear-cell renal cell carcinoma developed progressive fatigue and exertional dyspnea 14 days after his first and only cycle of nivolumab and ipilimumab. Electrocardiography revealed complete atrioventricular block. High-sensitivity cardiac troponin T increased from 2575 to 11,327 pg/mL, whereas creatine kinase initially decreased from 8690 U/L before rising again. Coronary angiography excluded obstructive coronary artery disease. Temporary transvenous pacing was followed by permanent pacemaker implantation. Despite intensive care, the patient developed progressive hemodynamic deterioration requiring vasopressor support and ultimately fatal cardiorespiratory collapse. ICI-associated myocarditis was not recognized during life; therefore, no myocarditis-directed diagnostic work-up or immunosuppressive treatment was initiated. Post-mortem examination demonstrated pronounced diffuse lymphohistiocytic myocarditis involving both atria and ventricles. ICI-associated myocarditis was identified as the cause of death, with a concomitant retroperitoneal abscess with pancreatic fistulation considered an aggravating condition. Conclusions: Complete atrioventricular block accompanied by a marked dynamic troponin increase should raise suspicion of ICI-associated myocarditis, particularly after exclusion of obstructive coronary artery disease. In this case, the diagnosis was established only post mortem. Earlier recognition of this clinical constellation may facilitate timely myocarditis-directed diagnostic evaluation and treatment.

AI.tldr: 79岁转移性肾癌患者在接受纳武利尤单抗联合伊匹木单抗后14天出现完全性房室传导阻滞和高敏肌钙蛋白显著升高，尸检证实为暴发性免疫检查点抑制剂相关心肌炎，生前未识别。
AI.motivation: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）相关心肌炎罕见但可致命，联合PD-1与CTLA-4阻断时风险增加，可表现为传导异常、室性心律失常、心源性休克和心脏性猝死。临床对以完全性房室传导阻滞为首发表现的暴发性心肌炎认识不足，易漏诊。
AI.method: 个案报告。对象为79岁男性转移性透明细胞肾细胞癌患者，接受首个且唯一一周期纳武利尤单抗联合伊匹木单抗治疗后14天出现进行性乏力与劳力性呼吸困难。检查包括心电图、高敏肌钙蛋白T、肌酸激酶、冠状动脉造影、临时经静脉起搏及永久起搏器植入，最终尸检明确诊断。摘要未报告系统性的统计方法。
AI.result: 心电图显示完全性房室传导阻滞；高敏肌钙蛋白T从2575 pg/mL升至11327 pg/mL，肌酸激酶先从8690 U/L下降后再次升高；冠状动脉造影排除阻塞性冠心病。予临时经静脉起搏并植入永久起搏器，但患者血流动力学进行性恶化，需血管活性药物支持，最终死于心肺衰竭。生前未识别ICI相关心肌炎，未行心肌炎针对性检查或免疫抑制治疗。尸检示双心房及心室弥漫性淋巴组织细胞性心肌炎，死因为ICI相关心肌炎，合并腹膜后脓肿伴胰腺瘘形成加重病情。
AI.conclusion: 完全性房室传导阻滞伴肌钙蛋白显著动态升高，尤其在排除阻塞性冠心病后，应高度怀疑ICI相关心肌炎。本例诊断仅在尸检后确立，早期识别这一临床组合有助于及时开展心肌炎针对性评估与治疗。局限性为单例报告，结论外推需谨慎。
