title: The Safety and Feasibility of Monitoring Cardiac Arrhythmic Events Before and After Conversion From Conventional Intermittent Hemodialysis to Home Nocturnal Hemodialysis: A Pilot Study.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Patients on hemodialysis have an increased risk of sudden cardiac death and an increased cardiac arrhythmia burden due to large fluid and electrolyte shifts, especially during the long inter-dialytic period. Arrhythmia burden may be decreased on home nocturnal hemodialysis due to prolonged fluid removal and clearance. This study examined the safety and feasibility of prolonged cardiac monitoring in patients who were converting from conventional hemodialysis (12 h) to home nocturnal hemodialysis (30+ h).

METHODS: Patients from a single center in Toronto, Ontario, Canada with a low cardiac risk profile, who were eligible to perform hemodialysis at home, were enrolled. Participants underwent the insertion of an implantable loop recorder and cardiac arrhythmia were monitored during conventional hemodialysis, and for 1 year after conversion to home nocturnal hemodialysis.

FINDINGS: Ten participants completed the study. The average ultrafiltration rate per session during conventional hemodialysis was 6.87 mL/h/kg, and the average cardiac ejection fraction was 52.6%. There were no adverse effects associated with implantable loop recorder implantation, usage, or removal. One participant recorded three sinus bradycardia and two sinus pause events during conventional hemodialysis that resolved after conversion to home nocturnal hemodialysis. All other participants did not experience any arrhythmic events before or after conversion to home nocturnal hemodialysis.

DISCUSSION: Our pilot study demonstrated a safe and feasible protocol for prolonged monitoring of cardiac arrhythmia in a stable population undergoing conversion from conventional to home nocturnal hemodialysis. Due to the small sample size, future work is required to delineate the full effect of home nocturnal hemodialysis on cardiac arrhythmia burden in patients with increased cardiac comorbidities.

AI.tldr: 在低心脏风险的血液透析患者中，从传统间歇性血透转为家庭夜间血透后，植入式循环记录仪监测显示心律失常事件减少，且监测方案安全可行。
AI.motivation: 血液透析患者因液体和电解质大幅波动，尤其在长透析间期，心律失常负担和心源性猝死风险增加。家庭夜间血透因延长液体清除和透析时间，可能降低心律失常负担，但缺乏持续心电监测的证据。
AI.method: 单中心前瞻性先导研究，纳入加拿大Toronto地区低心脏风险且适合家庭透析的患者，植入植入式循环记录仪，在传统血透期间及转为家庭夜间血透后1年内监测心律失常事件。样本量10例，主要评估监测方案的安全性和可行性，终点为心律失常事件。
AI.result: 10例完成研究。传统血透期间平均超滤率6.87 mL/h/kg，平均心脏射血分数52.6%。植入式循环记录仪植入、使用和移除均无不良事件。1例在传统血透期间记录到3次窦性心动过缓和2次窦性停搏，转为家庭夜间血透后未再发生；其余患者转换前后均无心律失常事件。
AI.conclusion: 本先导研究显示，在稳定透析患者中从传统血透转为家庭夜间血透，采用植入式循环记录仪长期监测心律失常是安全可行的，且1例患者的心律失常事件在转换后消失。但样本量小，需更大规模研究明确家庭夜间血透对合并更多心脏疾病患者心律失常负担的影响。

summary_zh:
引言：血液透析患者因大量液体和电解质转移，尤其是在较长的透析间期，发生心脏性猝死的风险增加，心律失常负荷也增加。家庭夜间血液透析由于延长了液体清除和溶质清除的时间，可能降低心律失常负荷。本研究考察了从常规血液透析（12小时）转换为家庭夜间血液透析（30+小时）的患者进行长期心脏监测的安全性和可行性。

方法：纳入来自加拿大安大略省多伦多市单中心、心脏风险较低且符合家庭血液透析条件的患者。参与者植入植入式循环记录仪，并在常规血液透析期间以及转换为家庭夜间血液透析后1年内监测心律失常。

结果：十名参与者完成了研究。常规血液透析期间每次治疗的平均超滤率为6.87 mL/h/kg，平均心脏射血分数为52.6%。植入式循环记录仪的植入、使用或取出均未出现不良反应。一名参与者在常规血液透析期间记录了三次窦性心动过缓和两次窦性停搏事件，这些事件在转换为家庭夜间血液透析后消失。所有其他参与者在转换为家庭夜间血液透析前后均未发生任何心律失常事件。

讨论：我们的初步研究表明，对于从常规血液透析转换为家庭夜间血液透析的稳定患者群体，长期监测心律失常的方案是安全可行的。由于样本量小，未来需要进一步研究以阐明家庭夜间血液透析对心脏合并症增加患者心律失常负荷的全面影响。

title: Erythrocyte Membrane β-Adrenoreactivity as a Systemic Adrenergic Phenotype Associated with Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia in Heart Failure Patients Undergoing Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy.
summary: Chronic hyperactivity of the sympathetic nervous system and remodeling of β-adrenergic receptors represent core pathophysiological mechanisms in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and in the emergence of ventricular arrhythmias. Nevertheless, clinically applicable functional indicators of this axis are still limited. We investigated whether erythrocyte membrane β-adrenoreactivity (EMA), an indirect functional membrane index derived from β-adrenergic antagonist-modulated hypo-osmotic hemolysis, correlates with a ventricular tachyarrhythmia (VTA) phenotype following cardiac resynchronization therapy with defibrillation capability (CRT-D). In a single-center observational cohort, 99 HFrEF patients underwent CRT-D implantation. A total of 70 patients with complete baseline and 12-month data formed the complete-case analysis (NCT03667989: n = 14; NCT05769036: n = 36; non-registry enrollment under the same institutional protocol: n = 20). Patients were categorized by the prespecified database variable "VTA preCRT and 12 m. post-CRT" into VTA-positive (n = 38) and VTA-negative (n = 32) groups. Baseline EMA was higher in VTA-positive patients (31.4% [22.8; 48.3]) than in VTA-negative patients (22.0% [15.8; 33.4]; p = 0.012). In multivariate logistic regression with stepwise selection, two variables were independently associated with the VTA-positive phenotype: EMA (odds ratio [OR] = 1.0446 per 1%; 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.0092-1.0812; p = 0.013) and left ventricular end-systolic dimension (LVESD) (OR = 1.1023 per 1 mm; 95% CI 1.0102-1.2029; p = 0.029). The model was statistically significant (likelihood-ratio χ2 = 12.567; p = 0.0019) and well calibrated (Hosmer-Lemeshow χ2 = 9.70; p = 0.286), with good discrimination (AUC = 0.748; 95% CI 0.629-0.844). However, explanatory power was modest (Nagelkerke R2 = 0.220), indicating that most variance in the VTA phenotype remains unexplained by EMA and LVESD. At a cut-off of 0.5, sensitivity was 73.68%, specificity 71.87%, and overall accuracy 72.86%. Internal validation with 2000 bootstrap iterations confirmed robustness (optimism-corrected AUC = 0.727; 95% CI 0.612-0.835). EMA remained significant after adjustment for LVESD, supporting its role as an independent marker of the VTA-positive phenotype. The model outperformed all univariate models in terms of AUC, R2, and overall accuracy. EMA may therefore be associated with a systemic adrenergic membrane phenotype and an arrhythmic substrate. These findings require mechanistic validation and external replication before any clinical application. All reported cut-offs are exploratory and derived from a single center, and the analysis is based on a complete-case cohort with acknowledged potential for attrition bias.

AI.tldr: 在HFrEF接受CRT-D的患者中，基线红细胞膜β-肾上腺素能反应性（EMA）与室性快速性心律失常（VTA）表型独立相关，但模型解释力有限。
AI.motivation: 慢性交感神经过度激活和β肾上腺素能受体重塑是HFrEF及室性心律失常的核心机制，但临床可用的功能性指标有限。本研究探讨EMA（一种基于β受体拮抗剂调节的低渗溶血试验的间接膜功能指数）是否与CRT-D术后的VTA表型相关。
AI.method: 单中心观察性队列研究，纳入99例接受CRT-D植入的HFrEF患者，其中70例有完整基线和12个月数据进入完整病例分析。根据预设数据库变量“VTA preCRT and 12 m. post-CRT”分为VTA阳性组（n=38）和VTA阴性组（n=32）。主要终点为VTA阳性表型。采用多因素logistic回归（逐步选择法）分析基线EMA与VTA的关联，并进行内部验证（2000次bootstrap）。
AI.result: VTA阳性组基线EMA高于阴性组（31.4% [22.8; 48.3] vs 22.0% [15.8; 33.4]，p=0.012）。多因素分析中，EMA（每增加1%：OR=1.0446，95%CI 1.0092-1.0812，p=0.013）和左室收缩末期内径（LVESD）（每增加1 mm：OR=1.1023，95%CI 1.0102-1.2029，p=0.029）与VTA阳性表型独立相关。模型有统计学意义（似然比χ2=12.567，p=0.0019），校准良好（Hosmer-Lemeshow χ2=9.70，p=0.286），区分度良好（AUC=0.748，95%CI 0.629-0.844），但解释力中等（Nagelkerke R2=0.220）。切点0.5时，敏感度73.68%，特异度71.87%，准确率72.86%。内部验证乐观校正AUC=0.727（95%CI 0.612-0.835）。
AI.conclusion: EMA可能是与系统性肾上腺素能膜表型和致心律失常基质相关的独立标志物，但模型解释力有限，且研究为单中心完整病例分析，存在 attrition bias 可能，所有切点均为探索性，需机制验证和外部重复后方可临床应用。

summary_zh: 交感神经系统慢性过度活跃和β肾上腺素能受体重塑是射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）及室性心律失常发生的核心病理生理机制。然而，该轴在临床上可应用的功能性指标仍然有限。我们研究了红细胞膜β肾上腺素能反应性（EMA）——一种由β肾上腺素能拮抗剂调节的低渗溶血衍生的间接功能性膜指标——是否与具有除颤功能的心脏再同步治疗（CRT-D）后室性快速性心律失常（VTA）表型相关。在一项单中心观察性队列中，99例HFrEF患者接受了CRT-D植入。共有70例具有完整基线和12个月数据的患者构成完整病例分析（NCT03667989：n = 14；NCT05769036：n = 36；同一机构方案下的非注册入组：n = 20）。根据预设数据库变量“VTA preCRT and 12 m. post-CRT”将患者分为VTA阳性组（n = 38）和VTA阴性组（n = 32）。VTA阳性患者的基线EMA高于VTA阴性患者（31.4% [22.8; 48.3] vs 22.0% [15.8; 33.4]；p = 0.012）。在采用逐步选择的多变量逻辑回归中，两个变量与VTA阳性表型独立相关：EMA（每1%的比值比[OR] = 1.0446；95%置信区间[CI] 1.0092-1.0812；p = 0.013）和左心室收缩末期内径（LVESD）（每1 mm的OR = 1.1023；95% CI 1.0102-1.2029；p = 0.029）。该模型具有统计学显著性（似然比χ2 = 12.567；p = 0.0019）且校准良好（Hosmer-Lemeshow χ2 = 9.70；p = 0.286），具有良好的区分度（AUC = 0.748；95% CI 0.629-0.844）。然而，解释力中等（Nagelkerke R2 = 0.220），表明VTA表型的大部分变异仍无法由EMA和LVESD解释。在0.5的截断值下，敏感性为73.68%，特异性为71.87%，总体准确率为72.86%。采用2000次bootstrap迭代的内部验证证实了稳健性（乐观校正AUC = 0.727；95% CI 0.612-0.835）。调整LVESD后EMA仍具有显著性，支持其作为VTA阳性表型独立标志物的作用。该模型在AUC、R2和总体准确率方面优于所有单变量模型。因此，EMA可能与全身性肾上腺素能膜表型和心律失常基质相关。这些发现需要在任何临床应用之前进行机制验证和外部重复。所有报告的截断值均为探索性的且源自单中心，分析基于完整病例队列，承认存在潜在的选择偏倚。

title: Abuse of Anabolic-Androgenic Steroids: Molecular and Organ Dysfunctions-A Critical Narrative Review for Forensic Interpretation.
summary: Anabolic-androgenic steroids (AAS) comprise testosterone and synthetic androgenic compounds that differ substantially in pharmacokinetics, receptor activity, route of administration, hepatic metabolism, and clinical risk. From a forensic perspective, the central problem is not simply to catalogue adverse effects but to determine how verified exposure, chronology, co-use of other substances, clinical and electrocardiographic findings, pathological alterations, and toxicological results should be integrated when evaluating an individual death. This critical narrative review therefore distinguishes therapeutic testosterone replacement from non-medical and supraphysiological AAS exposure and examines the evidence connecting exposure to endocrine, cardiovascular, hepatic, renal, musculoskeletal, neuropsychiatric, and immunological findings. Human prospective and observational data support associations between androgen abuse and endocrine suppression, erythrocytosis, adverse lipid changes, increased blood pressure, and left-ventricular structural or functional alterations, with recovery of selected measured parameters reported in the studied cohorts. Electrocardiographic studies also report prolonged repolarization indices and impaired heart-rate recovery in AAS-using bodybuilders; however, these intermediate markers do not by themselves establish an individual risk of fatal ventricular arrhythmia. Forensic autopsy series describe myocardial hypertrophy, fibrosis, coronary disease, and other lesions in AAS-associated deaths, but these findings are not specific and require correlation with toxicology, clinical history, circumstances, and alternative causes. The detailed immunological literature is predominantly mechanistic, in vitro, or experimental and currently provides limited direct forensic evidence in human AAS users. Similarly, Raman spectroscopy is best regarded as a developing adjunct for forensic trace or analytical applications rather than a validated method for confirming AAS accumulation or cause of death in post-mortem tissue. We propose a structured forensic framework in which exposure is first verified, the temporal and pharmacological context is reconstructed, findings are assessed for specificity and plausibility, co-exposures and competing causes are examined, and the final opinion explicitly communicates the degree of certainty and the limitations of the evidence.

AI.tldr: 该叙述性综述指出，合成代谢雄激素类固醇滥用与内分泌抑制、红细胞增多、血脂异常、血压升高及左室结构功能改变相关，心电图复极延长和心率恢复受损，但个体致命性室性心律失常风险及尸检发现缺乏特异性，需结合毒理学与临床史综合判断。
AI.motivation: 从法医学角度，核心问题并非简单罗列AAS不良反应，而是如何整合确证暴露、时间线、合并用药、临床与心电图表现、病理改变及毒理结果来评估个体死亡；既往证据多局限于机制或观察性研究，缺乏对AAS暴露与多器官损伤及心律失常风险的系统性法医学评估框架。
AI.method: 关键叙述性综述，区分治疗性睾酮替代与非医疗/超生理剂量AAS暴露，检索并分析内分泌、心血管、肝脏、肾脏、骨骼肌、神经精神及免疫相关的人体前瞻性与观察性研究、心电图研究、法医尸检系列及免疫学文献，提出结构化法医评估框架，未报告样本量及统计方法。
AI.result: 人体研究支持AAS滥用与内分泌抑制、红细胞增多、不良血脂变化、血压升高及左室结构或功能改变相关，部分队列报告所选参数可恢复；心电图研究报告使用AAS的健美者复极指标延长和心率恢复受损，但这些中间标志物本身不能确立个体致命性室性心律失常风险；尸检系列描述心肌肥厚、纤维化、冠心病等病变，但缺乏特异性；免疫学文献多为机制、体外或实验性研究，直接法医证据有限；拉曼光谱尚属发展中辅助手段。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: AAS滥用与多器官亚临床及结构性损伤相关，心电图复极延长和心率恢复受损提示致心律失常基质，但现有证据不足以个体化预测致命性室性心律失常；法医评估应遵循结构化框架：先确证暴露、重建时间与药理背景、评估发现特异性与合理性、排查合并暴露与竞争性死因，并明确表述证据确定性及局限性。

summary_zh: 蛋白同化雄性类固醇（AAS）包括睾酮及合成雄激素类化合物，这些化合物在药代动力学、受体活性、给药途径、肝脏代谢和临床风险方面存在显著差异。从法医学角度看，核心问题不仅仅是列举不良反应，而是确定在评估个体死亡时，如何整合确证的暴露、时间顺序、其他物质的合并使用、临床和心电图发现、病理改变以及毒理学结果。因此，本批判性叙述综述将治疗性睾酮替代与非医疗及超生理剂量的AAS暴露区分开来，并审查将暴露与内分泌、心血管、肝脏、肾脏、肌肉骨骼、神经精神及免疫学发现联系起来的证据。人类前瞻性和观察性数据支持雄激素滥用与内分泌抑制、红细胞增多、不良血脂变化、血压升高以及左心室结构或功能改变之间的关联，所研究的队列中报告了部分测量参数的恢复。心电图研究还报告，使用AAS的健美运动员出现复极指数延长和心率恢复受损；然而，这些中间标志物本身并不能确立个体发生致命性室性心律失常的风险。法医尸检系列描述了AAS相关死亡中的心肌肥厚、纤维化、冠状动脉疾病及其他病变，但这些发现并不特异，需要与毒理学、临床病史、具体情况及替代原因进行关联分析。详细的免疫学文献主要是机制性、体外或实验性的，目前在使用AAS的人群中提供的直接法医学证据有限。同样，拉曼光谱最好被视为法医痕量或分析应用中的一种发展中的辅助手段，而非用于确认死后组织中AAS蓄积或死因的验证方法。我们提出了一个结构化的法医框架，其中首先核实暴露，重建时间和药理学背景，评估发现的特异性和合理性，检查合并暴露和竞争性原因，最终意见明确传达确定性程度和证据的局限性。

title: Device-Derived Digital Biomarkers During SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy: A Secondary Analysis of the ERASe Trial.
summary: Aims: Implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICD) and cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillators (CRT-D) provide continuous physiological data reflecting heart failure (HF) status and autonomic tone. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) are core HF therapy, but it remains unclear whether their physiological effects are detectable using device-based remote monitoring. Following the ERASe trial, which showed reduced ventricular arrhythmias with ertugliflozin, this post-hoc analysis evaluated its impact on ICD/CRT-D-derived parameters. Methods: In this prospective, randomized ERASe post-hoc analysis, ertugliflozin was compared with placebo over 12 months in patients with ICD or CRT-D devices. Device-derived parameters including 24 h heart rate, night heart rate, heart rate variability, physical activity, and thoracic impedance were assessed at baseline and follow-up. Analyses were predefined as exploratory. Results: Forty-six patients (22 ertugliflozin, 24 placebo) had ≥1 analysable parameter. Paired longitudinal data were available for 29 patients for 24 h heart rate (HR), 19 for night HR, 17 for HR variability, and 9 for thoracic impedance. No significant between-group differences were observed in 24 h HR, physical activity or thoracic impedance. No significant differential longitudinal treatment effects were observed for the evaluated device-derived parameters, although estimates were imprecise because of limited parameter-specific data availability. Assessment of associations with arrhythmic and heart-failure outcomes was precluded by small event numbers and incomplete parameter-specific data. Conclusions: Ertugliflozin did not significantly alter individual device-derived parameters. Larger studies are needed to determine whether device-based physiological signals can identify treatment-related changes.

AI.tldr: 在ICD/CRT-D患者中，厄格列净治疗12个月未显著改变设备衍生的心率、心率变异性、体力活动及胸阻抗等参数，但样本量小致估计不精确。
AI.motivation: SGLT2抑制剂是心衰核心治疗，但其生理效应能否通过ICD/CRT-D远程监测参数检测尚不明确。ERASe试验显示厄格列净减少室性心律失常，本分析旨在评估其对设备衍生参数的影响。
AI.method: ERASe试验的事后分析，前瞻性随机对照设计，比较厄格列净与安慰剂治疗12个月，纳入植入ICD或CRT-D的患者。评估基线及随访时的设备参数：24小时心率、夜间心率、心率变异性、体力活动和胸阻抗。分析为预设探索性。
AI.result: 46例患者（厄格列净22例，安慰剂24例）有至少1个可分析参数。配对纵向数据：24小时心率29例，夜间心率19例，心率变异性17例，胸阻抗9例。组间24小时心率、体力活动或胸阻抗均无显著差异。评估的设备参数均未观察到显著的纵向治疗差异，但因参数特异性数据有限，估计不精确。心律失常和心衰结局的关联分析因事件数少和数据不完整未能进行。
AI.conclusion: 厄格列净未显著改变单个设备衍生参数。需要更大规模研究确定设备生理信号能否识别治疗相关变化。本研究受限于小样本和参数数据不完整，结论需谨慎解读。

summary_zh:
目的：植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）和心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）可提供反映心力衰竭（HF）状态和自主神经张力的连续生理数据。钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白-2抑制剂（SGLT2i）是HF的核心治疗药物，但其生理效应能否通过基于设备的远程监测检测到尚不清楚。ERASe试验显示厄格列净可减少室性心律失常，本事后分析评估了其对ICD/CRT-D衍生参数的影响。

方法：在这项前瞻性、随机化的ERASe事后分析中，比较了厄格列净与安慰剂在植入ICD或CRT-D装置患者中为期12个月的效果。在基线和随访时评估了设备衍生参数，包括24小时心率、夜间心率、心率变异性、体力活动和胸阻抗。分析预先定义为探索性。

结果：46例患者（22例厄格列净，24例安慰剂）有≥1个可分析参数。29例患者有24小时心率（HR）的配对纵向数据，19例有夜间HR，17例有HR变异性，9例有胸阻抗。在24小时HR、体力活动或胸阻抗方面未观察到显著的组间差异。对于所评估的设备衍生参数，未观察到显著的纵向治疗差异效应，尽管由于特定参数数据可得性有限，估计值不精确。由于事件数量少且特定参数数据不完整，无法评估与心律失常和心力衰竭结局的关联。

结论：厄格列净未显著改变个体设备衍生参数。需要更大规模的研究来确定基于设备的生理信号能否识别治疗相关的变化。

title: Wearing Protection or Wearing Assumptions? A Critical Reappraisal of the Wearable Cardioverter-Defibrillator.
summary: The wearable cardioverter-defibrillator (WCD) has become an accepted temporary strategy for patients considered at transient risk of sudden cardiac death and its use has rapidly expanded across a broad range of clinical settings. However, more than twenty years after its introduction, the evidence supporting its routine use remains surprisingly limited. This review revisits the background rationale, randomized evidence and observational literature. Rather than questioning the technical ability of the WCD to terminate ventricular arrhythmias, we critically examine whether available evidence demonstrates a meaningful improvement in prognosis. We discuss the lessons learned from early post-myocardial infarction Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator (ICD) trials, the limitations of using appropriate shocks as surrogate endpoints, the interpretation of the VEST trial, the strengths and weaknesses of registry-based evidence, patient adherence and quality-of-life issues, the economic implications of WCD therapy, and the need for a more selective, evidence-based use of the WCD that identifies patients most likely to derive meaningful clinical benefit while promoting responsible stewardship of healthcare resources.

AI.tldr: 综述指出可穿戴心律转复除颤器（WCD）虽广泛用于短暂性心脏性猝死风险患者，但缺乏改善预后的高质量证据，需选择性使用。
AI.motivation: WCD作为临时预防心脏性猝死的策略使用迅速扩大，但引入20余年后支持其常规使用的证据仍有限，需重新审视其预后获益。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，回顾WCD的背景原理、随机证据和观察性文献，批判性评估现有证据是否显示预后改善，并讨论早期心梗后ICD试验教训、适当放电作为替代终点的局限、VEST试验解读、注册证据优缺点、患者依从性与生活质量及经济影响。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果；综述指出WCD终止室性心律失常的技术能力并非争议焦点，但现有证据未能证明其带来有意义的预后改善，且适当放电作为替代终点存在局限。
AI.conclusion: WCD的常规使用缺乏改善预后的有力证据，应基于证据选择性用于最可能获益的患者，同时促进医疗资源合理使用；需更多高质量研究明确其临床价值。

summary_zh: 可穿戴式心律转复除颤器（WCD）已成为一种被接受的临时策略，用于被认为存在一过性心脏性猝死风险的患者，其使用已在广泛的临床环境中迅速扩展。然而，在其引入二十多年后，支持其常规使用的证据仍然出人意料地有限。本综述重新审视了背景依据、随机证据和观察性文献。我们并非质疑WCD终止室性心律失常的技术能力，而是批判性地检验现有证据是否证明其能带来有意义的预后改善。我们讨论了从早期心肌梗死后植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）试验中获得的经验教训、以适当放电作为替代终点的局限性、对VEST试验的解读、基于注册登记的证据的优势与不足、患者依从性与生活质量问题、WCD治疗的经济学影响，以及需要更有选择性地、基于证据地使用WCD，以识别最有可能获得有意义临床获益的患者，同时促进对医疗资源的负责任管理。

title: Same ejection fraction, different patient: has the defibrillator outlived its own trial data?
Predicting Persistent Left Ventricular Dysfunction After Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy Upgrade in Pacing-Induced Cardiomyopathy.
summary: Background/Objectives: Pacing-induced cardiomyopathy (PICM) is potentially reversible after cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) upgrade, but severe left ventricular dysfunction persists in some patients. We evaluated predictors of persistent left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 35% after CRT upgrade and long-term outcomes. Methods: We analysed 60 patients undergoing CRT upgrade for PICM. The primary outcome was persistent LVEF ≤ 35% at 12 months. Clinical, electrocardiographic, echocardiographic, and long-term outcomes were assessed. Results: At 12 months, median LVEF increased from 30% to 45% (p < 0.01), and 82% of patients recovered to an LVEF > 35%. Persistent severe left ventricular dysfunction was associated with lower baseline LVEF (22% vs. 30%; p < 0.01), greater left ventricular end-diastolic diameter (LVEDD) (65 mm vs. 58 mm; p = 0.03), and longer post-CRT QRS duration (154 ms vs. 140 ms; p = 0.02); none remained independently significant after multivariable adjustment. No patient with baseline LVEF > 25% and LVEDD < 65 mm had persistent severe LV dysfunction, compared with 46% of those with LVEF ≤ 25% and LVEDD ≥ 65 mm. In the 12-month landmark analysis, mortality through 60 months after CRT upgrade was 55% in patients with persistent severe LV dysfunction and 31% in those with LVEF recovery. Conclusions: CRT upgrade was associated with substantial recovery of LV systolic function in patients with PICM. Severe baseline LV dysfunction and LV dilatation were associated with a lower likelihood of recovery to an LVEF > 35%. These exploratory findings may aid risk stratification but require prospective validation.

AI.tldr: 在60例起搏诱导性心肌病（PICM）患者中，升级CRT后12个月82%患者LVEF恢复至>35%，基线LVEF低和左室扩大与持续严重左室功能不全相关，且后者长期死亡率更高。
AI.motivation: PICM在升级CRT后可能逆转，但部分患者仍存在严重左室功能不全，目前缺乏对持续左室功能不全的预测因素及长期结局的认识。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性分析60例因PICM行CRT升级的患者。主要终点为12个月时持续性LVEF≤35%。评估临床、心电图、超声心动图特征及长期结局，采用多变量分析寻找独立预测因素，并进行12个月 landmark 分析。
AI.result: 12个月时中位LVEF从30%升至45%（p<0.01），82%患者LVEF恢复至>35%。持续严重左室功能不全与较低基线LVEF（22% vs 30%，p<0.01）、较大左室舒张末径（LVEDD）（65 mm vs 58 mm，p=0.03）及CRT后较长QRS时限（154 ms vs 140 ms，p=0.02）相关，但多变量校正后均无独立显著性。基线LVEF>25%且LVEDD<65 mm者无持续严重左室功能不全，而LVEF≤25%且LVEDD≥65 mm者中46%出现。12个月 landmark 分析显示，持续严重左室功能不全者60个月死亡率55%，LVEF恢复者31%。
AI.conclusion: CRT升级可使PICM患者左室收缩功能显著恢复，但基线严重左室功能不全和左室扩大与恢复至LVEF>35%的可能性降低相关，且持续严重左室功能不全者长期死亡率更高。这些探索性发现有助于风险分层，但需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：起搏诱导性心肌病（PICM）在升级为心脏再同步治疗（CRT）后可能逆转，但部分患者仍存在持续性严重左心室功能障碍。我们评估了CRT升级后持续性左心室射血分数（LVEF）≤ 35%的预测因素及长期结局。方法：我们分析了60例因PICM接受CRT升级的患者。主要结局为12个月时持续性LVEF ≤ 35%。评估了临床、心电图、超声心动图及长期结局。结果：12个月时，中位LVEF从30%升至45%（p < 0.01），82%的患者LVEF恢复至> 35%。持续性严重左心室功能障碍与较低的基线LVEF（22% vs. 30%；p < 0.01）、较大的左心室舒张末期内径（LVEDD）（65 mm vs. 58 mm；p = 0.03）以及CRT后较长的QRS时限（154 ms vs. 140 ms；p = 0.02）相关；多变量校正后均无独立显著性。基线LVEF > 25%且LVEDD < 65 mm的患者中无一例出现持续性严重左心室功能障碍，而LVEF ≤ 25%且LVEDD ≥ 65 mm的患者中该比例为46%。在12个月界标分析中，CRT升级后60个月内的死亡率在持续性严重左心室功能障碍患者中为55%，在LVEF恢复患者中为31%。结论：CRT升级与PICM患者左心室收缩功能的显著恢复相关。严重的基线左心室功能障碍和左心室扩张与恢复至LVEF > 35%的可能性较低相关。这些探索性发现可能有助于风险分层，但需前瞻性验证。

title: One Catheter, Two Chambers: Feasibility and Acute Procedural Outcomes of Dual-Chamber Leadless Pacemaker Implantation with a Single Delivery Catheter.
summary: Background: Dual-chamber leadless pacing with the Aveir DR system restores atrioventricular synchrony without transvenous leads. The labeled implant workflow calls for a separate delivery catheter for each device. The second catheter adds cost and adds steps to the procedure, and whether it is actually needed has not been examined in a large series. Objective: To describe the acute procedural feasibility, the rate of delivery-catheter malfunction, and the effect on direct disposable supply cost of implanting both devices of a dual-chamber leadless pacemaker system through one delivery catheter. Methods: We reviewed 102 consecutive patients who received a dual-chamber leadless pacemaker at a single center between February 2024 and February 2025, implanted by five operators at that center. Twenty earlier dual-chamber implants performed with two catheters, before the single-catheter workflow was adopted, precede the study period and are not part of this cohort. The right ventricular device was placed first in every case. The same catheter was then reloaded with the atrial device and used for the second implant, and a new catheter was opened only if the first one failed. We recorded acute implant success, catheter malfunction, procedure time, fluoroscopy time, complications through 30 days after implantation, and direct disposable supply cost. Results: Both devices were implanted through the original catheter in 100 of 102 patients (98.0%, 95% CI 93.1 to 99.8%). Two patients (2.0%, 95% CI 0.2 to 6.9%) needed a catheter exchange because of a mechanical failure that arose during ventricular deployment; in both, the ventricular device had been recaptured and redeployed with repeated torque beforehand. No catheter failed during atrial implantation. Mean time from sheath insertion to removal was 69 min, and mean fluoroscopy time was 16.0 ± 6.6 min. Two device dislodgements occurred (2.0%, 95% CI 0.2 to 6.9%), one intraprocedural and one a right atrial device that embolized the day after implant; neither was related to the delivery catheter. There was no perforation, pericardial effusion, or access-site complication, and no other complication occurred in any patient through 30 days after implant. Omitting the second catheter lowered direct disposable supply cost by the cost of the second catheter. Conclusions: With experienced operators, one delivery catheter completed both implants in 98% of cases and lowered disposable supply cost. The study is single arm aand the number of events is small, so these findings support feasibility, with 30-day freedom from complications of 98.0%, and a supply cost difference.

AI.tldr: 在102例双腔无导线起搏器植入中，单根递送导管完成两腔植入的成功率达98.0%，未增加并发症且降低耗材成本。
AI.motivation: 双腔无导线起搏系统（Aveir DR）可恢复房室同步且无需经静脉导线，但标准流程要求每个器件使用单独的递送导管，增加费用和手术步骤；单导管完成双腔植入的可行性尚未在大样本中验证。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列，纳入2024年2月至2025年2月连续102例接受双腔无导线起搏器植入的患者，由5位术者操作。均先置入右心室器件，再以同一导管重新装载心房器件完成第二植入，仅当导管故障时更换新导管。记录急性植入成功率、导管故障率、手术时间、透视时间、30天并发症及直接一次性耗材成本。
AI.result: 100/102例（98.0%，95%CI 93.1-99.8%）经原导管完成双腔植入；2例（2.0%，95%CI 0.2-6.9%）因心室部署时机械故障需更换导管，均发生于反复扭矩操作后，心房植入阶段无导管故障。平均手术时间69分钟，平均透视时间16.0±6.6分钟。2例（2.0%）发生器件脱位（1例术中，1例术后次日右心房器件栓塞），均与递送导管无关。无穿孔、心包积液或穿刺部位并发症，30天内无其他并发症。省略第二根导管降低了第二根导管对应的直接耗材成本。
AI.conclusion: 在有经验的术者中，单根递送导管完成双腔无导线起搏器植入可行率高（98%），30天无并发症率98.0%，并降低耗材成本。但本研究为单臂设计且事件数少，结论仅支持可行性，需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：使用 Aveir DR 系统的双腔无导线起搏可在无需经静脉导线的情况下恢复房室同步。标签规定的植入流程要求每个装置使用单独的输送导管。第二根导管增加了成本并增加了手术步骤，而是否真正需要第二根导管尚未在大系列研究中得到检验。目的：描述通过一根输送导管植入双腔无导线起搏器系统两个装置的急性手术可行性、输送导管故障率以及对直接一次性耗材成本的影响。方法：我们回顾了2024年2月至2025年2月期间在单中心接受双腔无导线起搏器的连续102例患者，由该中心的五位术者植入。在采用单导管流程之前，有二十例较早的双腔植入使用两根导管完成，这些病例在研究期之前，不属于本队列。所有病例均先放置右心室装置。随后将同一根导管重新装载心房装置并用于第二次植入，仅在首根导管失败时才打开新导管。我们记录了急性植入成功率、导管故障、手术时间、透视时间、植入后30天内的并发症以及直接一次性耗材成本。结果：102例患者中有100例（98.0%，95% CI 93.1至99.8%）通过原导管植入了两个装置。2例患者（2.0%，95% CI 0.2至6.9%）因心室部署期间出现的机械故障需要更换导管；在这两例中，心室装置此前均已被回收并重新部署，且伴有反复扭矩。心房植入期间无导管故障。从鞘管插入到移除的平均时间为69分钟，平均透视时间为16.0 ± 6.6分钟。发生了两例装置脱位（2.0%，95% CI 0.2至6.9%），一例为术中发生，另一例为右心房装置在植入次日栓塞；两者均与输送导管无关。无穿孔、心包积液或穿刺部位并发症，且植入后30天内任何患者均未发生其他并发症。省略第二根导管使直接一次性耗材成本降低了第二根导管的成本。结论：在经验丰富的术者操作下，一根输送导管在98%的病例中完成了两次植入，并降低了一次性耗材成本。该研究为单臂研究且事件数量较少，因此这些发现支持可行性，30天无并发症率为98.0%，并存在耗材成本差异。

title: Tailored therapy for bradyarrhythmias: integrating leadless pacing, conduction system pacing, and cardioneuroablation.
summary: Bradyarrhythmias represent a heterogeneous group of disorders ranging from intrinsic cardiac disease to functional autonomic disturbances. Although conventional transvenous pacing remains the cornerstone of treatment, a uniform device-based approach may not adequately address the diverse pathophysiological substrates underlying bradyarrhythmias. Device-related complications, pacing-induced ventricular dysfunction, and the growing recognition of vagally mediated bradyarrhythmias have highlighted the need for a more individualized therapeutic strategy. Recent advances have expanded the available treatment options through the development of leadless pacing, conduction system pacing (CSP), and cardioneuroablation (CNA). Importantly, these therapies should not be viewed as interchangeable alternatives, but rather as complementary approaches targeting distinct clinical scenarios. Leadless pacing minimizes transvenous hardware and may be particularly advantageous in patients at increased risk of device-related complications, limited venous access, or low anticipated pacing requirements. CSP preserves physiological ventricular activation and may reduce the risk of pacing-induced cardiomyopathy in patients with a high expected ventricular pacing burden or a vulnerable ventricular substrate. Conversely, CNA provides a mechanism-based, device-free therapeutic option for carefully selected patients with functional, vagally mediated bradyarrhythmias. In this review, we propose a practical framework for patient selection based on three complementary phenotypes: the high-risk and low-pacing-burden patient, the high-pacing-burden and vulnerable ventricle, and the vagal phenotype (see Central Illustration). By integrating pathophysiology, anticipated pacing burden, ventricular susceptibility, and autonomic substrate, contemporary management can move beyond the traditional device-centered paradigm toward a tailored approach aimed at delivering the right therapy to the right patient.

AI.tldr: 本综述提出基于三种表型的个体化起搏治疗框架：高危低起搏负荷者选无导线起搏，高起搏负荷伴心室脆弱者选传导系统起搏，迷走神经介导者选心脏神经消融。
AI.motivation: 缓慢性心律失常涵盖从心脏内在病变到功能性自主神经紊乱的多种机制，传统经静脉起搏虽为主要手段，但统一的器械策略难以匹配不同病理基础；器械相关并发症、起搏诱导的心室功能障碍以及对迷走神经介导性缓慢性心律失常认识的加深，均提示需要更个体化的治疗策略。
AI.method: 本文为综述性文章，未纳入具体患者样本，也未进行原始统计分析。作者系统梳理无导线起搏、传导系统起搏（CSP）与心脏神经消融（CNA）三种新技术的适用场景，提出按三种互补临床表型进行患者选择的实用框架：①高危且低起搏负荷患者；②高起搏负荷且心室脆弱患者；③迷走神经表型患者。选择维度包括病理生理机制、预期起搏负荷、心室易损性与自主神经基质。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量研究数据、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。定性结论为：无导线起搏减少经静脉硬件，可能更适合器械并发症风险高、静脉通路受限或预期起搏需求低的患者；CSP 保留生理性心室激动，可能降低高预期起搏负荷或心室基质脆弱患者的起搏诱导性心肌病风险；CNA 为经严格筛选的功能性、迷走神经介导性缓慢性心律失常患者提供基于机制、无需植入器械的治疗选择。三者并非可互换的替代方案，而是针对不同临床场景的互补手段。
AI.conclusion: 当代缓慢性心律失常管理应从以器械为中心的传统模式转向整合病理生理、预期起搏负荷、心室易损性与自主神经基质的个体化策略，实现“合适的治疗给合适的患者”。对电生理实践而言，该框架有助于在无导线起搏、CSP 与 CNA 之间做出结构化选择。局限性在于本文为综述与观点性框架，缺乏前瞻性对照数据验证各表型的获益，摘要亦未报告具体疗效数值。

summary_zh: 缓慢性心律失常代表一组异质性疾病，范围从内在心脏疾病到功能性自主神经紊乱。尽管传统经静脉起搏仍是治疗的基石，但统一的基于器械的方法可能无法充分应对缓慢性心律失常背后的多样病理生理基础。器械相关并发症、起搏诱导的心室功能障碍以及对迷走神经介导的缓慢性心律失常的日益认识，凸显了需要更个体化的治疗策略。近期进展通过无导线起搏、传导系统起搏（CSP）和心脏神经消融（CNA）的发展扩大了可用的治疗选择。重要的是，这些疗法不应被视为可互换的替代方案，而应视为针对不同临床场景的互补方法。无导线起搏最大限度地减少了经静脉硬件，对于器械相关并发症风险增加、静脉通路受限或预期起搏需求低的患者可能特别有利。CSP保留了生理性心室激动，对于预期心室起搏负荷高或心室基质脆弱的患者，可能降低起搏诱导的心肌病风险。相反，CNA为经过仔细筛选的功能性、迷走神经介导的缓慢性心律失常患者提供了一种基于机制、无器械的治疗选择。在本综述中，我们提出了一个基于三种互补表型的患者选择实用框架：高风险且低起搏负荷患者、高起搏负荷且心室脆弱患者以及迷走神经表型（见中央插图）。通过整合病理生理学、预期起搏负荷、心室易感性和自主神经基质，当代管理可以超越传统的以器械为中心的范式，转向旨在为正确患者提供正确治疗的定制化方法。

title: Changes in Ventilation Associated with Worsening Heart Failure in Ambulatory Patients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Breathlessness is a cardinal symptom of heart failure (HF) and reflects abnormal ventilation, particularly during exercise. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing provides only a snapshot of ventilatory physiology and cannot capture longitudinal changes associated with deterioration. Continuous physiologic monitoring from implantable devices offers an opportunity to characterize ventilatory trends preceding HF events in ambulatory patients.

METHODS: The MultiSENSE study followed 900 patients with a cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator (CRT-D) modified to record high fidelity physiologic data. Ventilatory variables derived from thoracic impedance were examined before adjudicated HF events (hospitalization for HF or outpatient visit requiring IV diuretics) and between clinic visits associated with worsening dyspnea. Variables included respiratory rate (RR), tidal volume (TV), minute ventilation (MV) and Rapid Shallow Breathing Index (RSBI; RR/TV). Patient activity was assessed using a device-embedded accelerometer.

RESULTS: A total of 130 HF events from 92 patients were analyzed. In the 3 days preceding HF events, mean daily RR increased (adjusted mean change: 0.59 [95% CI: 0.31, 0.86], relative change: 3.56%, p<0.0001) and mean daily TV decreased (-0.07 [-0.10, -0.04], -7.4%, p<0.0001), resulting in a significant increase in RSBI (2.34 [1.56, 3.12], 10.5%, p<0.0001). Daily MV decreased (-0.72 [-1.2, -.23], -4.4%, p=0.0042), largely reflecting reduced activity. When accounting only for resting periods, a similar increase in RSBI was observed in the 3 days preceding HF events (1.98 [1.10, 2.86], 7.32%, p<0.0001) relative to baseline, whereas MV showed no significant change. In patients with worsening dyspnea between clinic visits, mean daily RR and RSBI increased significantly without a significant change in TV or MV.

CONCLUSIONS: Worsening HF in ambulatory patients is characterized by a shift toward rapid shallow breathing. RSBI significantly increased prior to HF events and with worsening dyspnea.. These findings suggest that RSBI may be a sensitive marker for worsening HF and may provide clinically relevant insight for monitoring ambulatory patients.

AI.tldr: 在CRT-D患者中，心衰事件前3天呼吸频率增快、潮气量降低，导致快速浅呼吸指数（RSBI）显著升高，提示RSBI可作为恶化心衰的敏感监测指标。
AI.motivation: 呼吸困难是心衰的核心症状，反映异常通气，但心肺运动试验仅提供瞬时信息，无法捕捉恶化相关的纵向通气变化。植入设备连续生理监测为描述心衰事件前通气趋势提供了机会。
AI.method: MultiSENSE研究纳入900例植入改良CRT-D（可记录高保真心电生理数据）的患者，通过胸阻抗衍生通气变量（呼吸频率RR、潮气量TV、分钟通气量MV、快速浅呼吸指数RSBI=RR/TV），分析裁定心衰事件（心衰住院或需静脉利尿剂的门诊就诊）前及门诊间呼吸困难加重时的变化，活动量用设备加速度计评估。
AI.result: 共分析92例患者的130次心衰事件。事件前3天，日均RR增加0.59（95%CI 0.31-0.86，相对变化3.56%，P<0.0001），TV降低-0.07（95%CI -0.10至-0.04，-7.4%，P<0.0001），RSBI升高2.34（95%CI 1.56-3.12，10.5%，P<0.0001）；MV降低-0.72（95%CI -1.2至-0.23，-4.4%，P=0.0042），主要反映活动减少。仅分析静息时段，事件前3天RSBI仍升高1.98（95%CI 1.10-2.86，7.32%，P<0.0001），MV无显著变化。门诊间呼吸困难加重患者日均RR和RSBI显著升高，TV和MV无显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 门诊心衰恶化以快速浅呼吸为特征，RSBI在心衰事件前及呼吸困难加重时显著升高，可能成为监测心衰恶化的敏感指标，为门诊患者管理提供临床相关洞察。但摘要未报告RSBI的预测阈值及对临床决策的影响，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：呼吸困难是心力衰竭（HF）的主要症状，反映通气异常，尤其在运动时。心肺运动试验仅提供通气生理的瞬时快照，无法捕捉与恶化相关的纵向变化。植入式设备的连续生理监测为描述门诊患者HF事件前的通气趋势提供了机会。

方法：MultiSENSE研究随访了900例植入心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）的患者，该设备经改良可记录高保真生理数据。在经裁定的HF事件（因HF住院或需静脉利尿剂的门诊就诊）前以及因呼吸困难加重而进行的门诊访视之间，检查了源自胸阻抗的通气变量。变量包括呼吸频率（RR）、潮气量（TV）、分钟通气量（MV）和快速浅呼吸指数（RSBI；RR/TV）。患者活动使用设备内置加速度计评估。

结果：共分析92例患者的130次HF事件。在HF事件前3天，平均每日RR增加（校正平均变化：0.59 [95% CI: 0.31, 0.86]，相对变化：3.56%，p<0.0001），平均每日TV降低（-0.07 [-0.10, -0.04]，-7.4%，p<0.0001），导致RSBI显著增加（2.34 [1.56, 3.12]，10.5%，p<0.0001）。每日MV降低（-0.72 [-1.2, -.23]，-4.4%，p=0.0042），主要反映活动减少。仅考虑静息时段时，相对于基线，HF事件前3天观察到RSBI类似增加（1.98 [1.10, 2.86]，7.32%，p<0.0001），而MV无显著变化。在门诊访视间呼吸困难加重的患者中，平均每日RR和RSBI显著增加，而TV或MV无显著变化。

结论：门诊患者HF恶化以向快速浅呼吸转变為特征。RSBI在HF事件前及呼吸困难加重时显著增加。这些发现提示RSBI可能是HF恶化的敏感标志物，并可能为监测门诊患者提供临床相关见解。

title: Cardioprotection and Heart Failure Management in Duchenne and Becker Muscular Dystrophies: A State-of-the-Art Review Across Pediatric and Transitional Age.
summary: Advances in respiratory care have significantly extended the life expectancy of patients with Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophies (DMD/BMD), making progressive dilated cardiomyopathy the leading cause of mortality in this population. Historically, a conservative "watch and wait" approach was often maintained until overt systolic dysfunction became evident. However, the advent of advanced echocardiographic technologies, particularly Global Longitudinal Strain (GLS) imaging, has demonstrated that myocardial impairment begins in early childhood, long before a decline in ejection fraction occurs. This critical evidence strongly advocates for a paradigm shift toward early, proactive cardioprotective strategies. As patients progress into the transitional age and adulthood, the pediatric prophylactic approach (traditionally based on ACE inhibitors and beta-blockers) must integrate with evolving adult heart failure guidelines. This comprehensive review critically evaluates the pathophysiological continuum of dystrophic cardiomyopathy. We highlight the prognostic value of early subclinical detection (GLS) and specifically discuss the transition to modern guideline-directed medical therapies (GDMTs), exploring the emerging role of Angiotensin Receptor-Neprilysin Inhibitors (ARNI, e.g., sacubitril/valsartan) and SGLT2 inhibitors (e.g., dapagliflozin) in this specific cohort. Finally, we address the role of advanced device therapies (ICD, CRT, and left ventricular assist devices) in end-stage disease. By bridging pediatric neurology and adult cardiology, this review aims to equip clinicians with an updated, multidisciplinary framework to optimize cardiovascular outcomes in the growing population of transitional-age DMD/BMD patients.

AI.tldr: DMD/BMD患者随呼吸支持延长寿命，扩张型心肌病成为主要死因；GLS可在射血分数下降前早期发现心肌损伤，支持早期启动心脏保护治疗并过渡至成人GDMT。
AI.motivation: DMD/BMD患者因呼吸护理进步寿命延长，进行性扩张型心肌病成为主要死亡原因。既往常采取保守“观察等待”策略直至收缩功能明显下降，但超声新技术（尤其GLS）显示心肌损伤在儿童早期即已出现，远早于LVEF下降，提示需转向早期、主动的心脏保护策略；同时过渡年龄及成人期需将儿科预防方案与成人心衰指南整合，而ARNI、SGLT2抑制剂等在该人群中的证据尚待明确。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述（state-of-the-art review），非原始研究，无样本量、干预分组及终点定义。综述系统评估肌营养不良性心肌病的病理生理连续过程，重点讨论GLS对亚临床心肌损伤的预后价值、从传统ACEI/β受体阻滞剂向现代指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）的过渡（包括ARNI如沙库巴曲缬沙坦、SGLT2抑制剂如达格列净在该特定人群中的新兴作用），以及终末期器械治疗（ICD、CRT、左心室辅助装置）的角色。摘要未报告系统检索策略或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告原始研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。综述指出：GLS影像证实心肌损伤始于儿童早期、早于射血分数下降；儿科预防性治疗传统以ACEI和β受体阻滞剂为基础；过渡年龄需整合成人心衰指南；ARNI与SGLT2抑制剂在该队列中的作用为新兴探索；终末期可考虑ICD、CRT及左心室辅助装置。
AI.conclusion: 综述主张DMD/BMD心肌病管理应从保守观察转向基于GLS早期亚临床检测的主动心脏保护，并在过渡年龄将儿科预防方案与成人GDMT（含ARNI、SGLT2抑制剂）衔接，终末期合理评估ICD、CRT及LVAD。临床意义在于桥接儿科神经科与成人心脏科，建立多学科框架以改善过渡年龄DMD/BMD患者心血管结局。局限性：本文为叙述性综述，无原始数据，ARNI与SGLT2抑制剂在该人群中的疗效与安全性证据仍有限，需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 呼吸护理的进步已显著延长了杜氏和贝克尔肌营养不良症（DMD/BMD）患者的预期寿命，使得进行性扩张型心肌病成为该人群的主要死亡原因。历史上，通常维持保守的“观察等待”策略，直至出现明显的收缩功能障碍。然而，先进超声心动图技术的出现，尤其是整体纵向应变（GLS）成像，已证明心肌损害始于儿童早期，远早于射血分数下降的发生。这一关键证据强烈主张向早期、主动的心脏保护策略转变。随着患者进入过渡年龄和成年期，儿科预防性方法（传统上基于ACE抑制剂和β受体阻滞剂）必须与不断发展的成人心力衰竭指南相结合。这篇综合综述批判性地评估了营养不良性心肌病的病理生理连续过程。我们强调了早期亚临床检测（GLS）的预后价值，并特别讨论了向现代指南指导的药物治疗（GDMTs）的过渡，探索了血管紧张素受体-脑啡肽酶抑制剂（ARNI，如沙库巴曲/缬沙坦）和SGLT2抑制剂（如达格列净）在这一特定队列中的新兴作用。最后，我们讨论了晚期疾病中先进器械治疗（ICD、CRT和左心室辅助装置）的作用。通过连接儿科神经病学和成人心脏病学，本综述旨在为临床医生提供一个更新的、多学科的框架，以优化不断增长的过渡年龄DMD/BMD患者人群的心血管结局。

title: Economic Evaluations of Algorithm-Enabled Remote Monitoring of Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices: Systematic Review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Algorithm-enabled remote monitoring using cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) is increasingly used to support earlier detection of clinical deterioration in heart failure and in at-risk populations. However, the economic value of these technologies remains uncertain because intervention design, implementation, and evaluation methods vary.

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to systematically identify, appraise, and synthesize full economic evaluations of algorithm-enabled CIED remote monitoring in adults with established heart failure or at risk of heart failure.

METHODS: A systematic review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) 2020 guidelines. Searches were performed in MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, with supplementary searches of health technology assessment sources. Eligible studies reported full economic evaluations of algorithm-enabled remote monitoring linked to CIEDs. Data were extracted using a structured form and synthesized narratively due to heterogeneity. Methodological and reporting quality were assessed using the CHEQUE (Criteria for Health Economic Quality Evaluation) checklist and CHEERS (Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards) 2022 statement. One reviewer screened records and extracted the data. A second reviewer independently checked subsets of the screening decisions and extracted the data.

RESULTS: Ten economic evaluations were included. They used models, trial data, or observational data; some were reported within health technology assessments. Substantial heterogeneity was observed in population definitions, intervention characteristics, algorithm types, monitored parameters, clinical response pathways, and economic methods. Cost-effectiveness and cost-utility analyses were most common, with time horizons ranging from short-term follow-up to lifetime modeling. Several studies reported economically favorable findings, including dominance (ie, less costly with better health outcomes) or cost-effectiveness. However, outcomes varied across studies, and favorable estimates often relied on assumptions about reduced hospitalization and length of stay, while quality-adjusted life year gains were generally modest. Reporting of key implementation factors, including alert burden and diagnostic performance, was limited.

CONCLUSIONS: There is economic evidence for algorithm-enabled CIED remote monitoring suggesting potential value in some settings, but the evidence remains methodologically heterogeneous and difficult to compare directly across studies. Findings are sensitive to differences in intervention design, modeling approaches, and clinical input data, which limit certainty and transferability. More robust and standardized evidence is needed before economic conclusions can be applied confidently across different devices, algorithms, and health care settings.

AI.tldr: 针对CIED算法远程监测的经济学评价系统综述发现，部分研究显示其具成本效果甚至占优，但方法异质性大、证据确定性低。
AI.motivation: 算法驱动的CIED远程监测用于心衰及高危人群的早期恶化检测日益普及，但其经济价值因干预设计、实施和评价方法差异而不确定，亟需系统梳理现有完整经济学评价。
AI.method: 按PRISMA 2020指南系统检索MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane Library并补充HTA来源，纳入成人已确诊或心衰高危人群中算法驱动CIED远程监测的完整经济学评价；因异质性采用叙述性综合，用CHEQUE清单和CHEERS 2022评估方法学与报告质量，一名评价者筛选提取、另一名独立核查部分数据。
AI.result: 共纳入10项经济学评价，采用模型、试验或观察数据，部分来自HTA报告；人群定义、干预特征、算法类型、监测参数、临床响应路径及经济学方法异质性显著，以成本效果和成本效用分析为主，时间跨度从短期随访到终身模型。部分研究报告占优（成本更低且健康产出更好）或具成本效果，但结果不一，有利估计多依赖住院和住院时长减少的假设，QALY增益普遍有限；警报负担和诊断性能等关键实施因素报告不足。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据提示算法驱动CIED远程监测在部分场景可能具经济价值，但方法异质性大、难以跨研究直接比较，结论对干预设计、建模方法和临床输入数据敏感，确定性和可迁移性有限；在将经济学结论自信应用于不同设备、算法和医疗环境前，需更稳健和标准化的证据。

summary_zh:
背景：使用心脏植入式电子设备（CIED）的算法远程监测越来越多地用于支持心衰和高危人群临床恶化的早期发现。然而，这些技术的经济价值仍不确定，因为干预设计、实施和评估方法各不相同。

目的：本研究旨在系统识别、评价和综合针对确诊心衰或存在心衰风险的成人中算法驱动的CIED远程监测的完整经济学评价。

方法：按照PRISMA（系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目）2020指南进行了系统评价。检索了MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane Library，并补充检索了卫生技术评估来源。符合条件的研究报告了与CIED相关的算法远程监测的完整经济学评价。使用结构化表格提取数据，并因异质性而进行叙述性综合。使用CHEQUE（卫生经济质量评价标准）清单和CHEERS（综合卫生经济评价报告标准）2022声明评估方法学和报告质量。一名评价者筛选记录并提取数据。第二名评价者独立核查筛选决定子集并提取数据。

结果：共纳入10项经济学评价。它们使用了模型、试验数据或观察性数据；部分在卫生技术评估中报告。在人群定义、干预特征、算法类型、监测参数、临床应答路径和经济学方法方面观察到显著异质性。成本效果和成本效用分析最为常见，时间范围从短期随访到终身建模不等。几项研究报告了经济上有利的结果，包括优势（即成本更低且健康结局更好）或成本效果。然而，各研究结果不一，有利估计往往依赖于减少住院和住院时间的假设，而质量调整生命年增益通常不大。关键实施因素（包括警报负担和诊断性能）的报告有限。

结论：有经济学证据表明算法驱动的CIED远程监测在某些情况下可能具有价值，但证据在方法学上仍存在异质性，难以在研究间直接比较。研究结果对干预设计、建模方法和临床输入数据的差异敏感，这限制了确定性和可转移性。在经济学结论能够自信地应用于不同设备、算法和医疗环境之前，需要更稳健和标准化的证据。

title: ENO1-Related Signaling in Hypertension-Associated Atrial Remodeling: Evidence Implicating PI3K/AKT and NOX4.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most prevalent sustained cardiac arrhythmia worldwide; hypertension is one of the most important risk factors for AF and contributes to both its initiation and maintenance. This study investigated the contribution of enolase 1 (ENO1) to hypertension-associated atrial remodeling and susceptibility to pacing-induced AF. Long-term hypertension was associated with increased AF inducibility in rats, and atrial transcriptomic analyses at two stages of hypertension identified persistent ENO1 upregulation. ENO1 was also increased in two external human left atrial AF datasets. An angiotensin II (Ang II)-induced atrial cardiomyocyte injury model was constructed to evaluate the role of ENO1 in Ang II-induced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy. In Ang II-stimulated primary neonatal rat atrial cardiomyocytes, siRNA-mediated ENO1 knockdown attenuated hypertrophic and oxidative-stress-related changes and was accompanied by lower PI3K/AKT phosphorylation and NADPH oxidase 4 (NOX4) expression. AP-III-a4 treatment produced concordant changes in selected cellular endpoints. PI3K inhibition reduced NOX4 expression and intracellular hydrogen peroxide levels. In ENO1-silenced cardiomyocytes, PI3K activation with 740Y-P partially increased both PI3K/AKT phosphorylation and NOX4 expression. In Ang II-infused hypertensive mice, AP-III-a4 treatment reduced atrial enlargement, fibrosis, PI3K/AKT phosphorylation, NOX4 expression, and atrial reactive oxygen species signals; it also attenuated atrial effective refractory period shortening. AP-III-a4 significantly shortened the duration of pacing-induced AF and was associated with numerically lower AF inducibility, although the latter difference did not reach statistical significance. Collectively, these findings support the involvement of PI3K/AKT signaling in ENO1-associated regulation of NOX4 and suggest that this relationship may contribute to the observed attenuation of hypertension-associated atrial remodeling.

AI.tldr: 高血压大鼠心房中ENO1持续上调，通过PI3K/AKT/NOX4通路促进心房重构和房颤易感性，抑制ENO1可减轻重构并缩短房颤持续时间。
AI.motivation: 高血压是房颤最重要的危险因素之一，参与房颤的始动与维持，但高血压相关心房重构的分子机制尚未完全阐明。既往证据提示烯醇化酶1（ENO1）可能参与心血管疾病，但其在高血压心房重构和房颤易感性中的作用及信号通路尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究采用长期高血压大鼠模型，评估房颤可诱发性，并对两个高血压阶段进行心房转录组分析；同时分析两个人左心房房颤外部数据集。体外构建血管紧张素II（Ang II）诱导的原代新生大鼠心房心肌细胞损伤模型，通过siRNA敲低ENO1、AP-III-a4处理及PI3K抑制/激活实验评估ENO1-PI3K/AKT-NOX4轴。体内对Ang II输注高血压小鼠给予AP-III-a4，评估心房扩大、纤维化、PI3K/AKT磷酸化、NOX4表达、活性氧信号、心房有效不应期及起搏诱发房颤持续时间和可诱发性。
AI.result: 长期高血压大鼠房颤可诱发性增加，两个高血压阶段心房转录组均显示ENO1持续上调；ENO1在两个人左心房房颤数据集中亦升高。在Ang II刺激的心房心肌细胞中，siRNA敲低ENO1减轻肥大和氧化应激相关改变，并降低PI3K/AKT磷酸化和NOX4表达；AP-III-a4处理产生一致变化；PI3K抑制降低NOX4表达和细胞内过氧化氢水平；在ENO1沉默细胞中，PI3K激活剂740Y-P部分恢复PI3K/AKT磷酸化和NOX4表达。在Ang II输注高血压小鼠中，AP-III-a4减轻心房扩大、纤维化、PI3K/AKT磷酸化、NOX4表达和心房活性氧信号，并减轻心房有效不应期缩短；AP-III-a4显著缩短起搏诱发房颤持续时间，房颤可诱发性数值上降低但未达统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究支持ENO1通过PI3K/AKT信号调控NOX4，参与高血压相关心房重构和房颤易感性；抑制ENO1相关通路可减轻心房重构并缩短房颤持续时间。这为高血压相关房颤的机制提供了新证据，但房颤可诱发性改善未达统计学显著，且研究限于动物和细胞模型，临床转化价值需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是全球最常见的持续性心律失常；高血压是AF最重要的危险因素之一，并促进其发生和维持。本研究探讨了烯醇化酶1（ENO1）在高血压相关心房重构及起搏诱导AF易感性中的作用。长期高血压与大鼠AF诱发性增加相关，在两个高血压阶段进行的心房转录组分析均发现ENO1持续上调。在两个外部人类左心房AF数据集中，ENO1也升高。构建了血管紧张素II（Ang II）诱导的心房心肌细胞损伤模型，以评估ENO1在Ang II诱导的心肌细胞肥大中的作用。在Ang II刺激的原代新生大鼠心房心肌细胞中，siRNA介导的ENO1敲低减轻了肥大和氧化应激相关变化，并伴随较低的PI3K/AKT磷酸化水平和NADPH氧化酶4（NOX4）表达。AP-III-a4处理在选定的细胞终点上产生了与之一致的变化。PI3K抑制降低了NOX4表达和细胞内过氧化氢水平。在ENO1沉默的心肌细胞中，用740Y-P激活PI3K部分增加了PI3K/AKT磷酸化和NOX4表达。在Ang II输注的高血压小鼠中，AP-III-a4治疗减轻了心房扩大、纤维化、PI3K/AKT磷酸化、NOX4表达和心房活性氧信号；它还减轻了心房有效不应期缩短。AP-III-a4显著缩短了起搏诱导的AF持续时间，并与数值上较低的AF诱发性相关，尽管后一差异未达到统计学显著性。总之，这些发现支持PI3K/AKT信号参与ENO1相关的NOX4调控，并提示这种关系可能有助于观察到的对高血压相关心房重构的减轻作用。

title: Familial severe non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy with coexisting likely pathogenic BAG3 and FLNC variants: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is genetically heterogeneous. In severe non-ischemic DCM with familial clustering of heart-failure deaths, genetic testing and pedigree analysis may clarify etiology and guide cascade screening.

CASE PRESENTATION: A 40-year-old woman presented with progressive dyspnea, chest tightness, and palpitations after an upper respiratory tract infection. Echocardiography showed severe left ventricular systolic dysfunction [left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) approximately 20%], left atrial enlargement, functional mitral regurgitation, and a small pericardial effusion. Serial cardiac troponin I and myocardial enzyme measurements remained within the reference ranges. Coronary angiography excluded obstructive coronary disease. Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) demonstrated global left ventricular hypokinesis and a clinically reported non-ischemic late-gadolinium-enhancement pattern at the papillary-muscle level involving the anterior/lateral wall. Because cardiac biomarkers remained normal and dedicated inflammatory CMR sequences were not acquired, active myocarditis could not be confirmed. Guideline-directed therapy reduced NT-proBNP from 4154 to 828 pg/mL, although angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor therapy was limited by symptomatic hypotension. At 2 months, symptoms and daily activity tolerance improved, but LVEF remained 25%, QTc was 479 ms, and ventricular premature complexes persisted. Whole-exome sequencing identified heterozygous likely pathogenic variants in BAG3 (NM_004281.4:c.180 + 1G > T) and FLNC [NM_001458.5:c.761_779del, p.(Leu254Profs*14)]. The daughter carried the BAG3 variant, whereas both children were negative for FLNC. The proband reported heart-failure-related deaths in her father and younger brother during adulthood and in a nephew during childhood.

CONCLUSIONS: The findings support complex familial non-ischemic DCM with marked variable expressivity. Coexisting BAG3 and FLNC variants should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating rather than proof of dual-gene causality. The infection-associated acute decompensation, persistently normal cardiac injury biomarkers, non-ischemic LGE, and incomplete inflammatory CMR characterization favor cautious interpretation rather than a definitive diagnosis of myocarditis. Serial imaging, rhythm surveillance, individualized device-risk assessment, and follow-up of genotype-positive relatives are essential.

AI.tldr: 一例40岁女性严重非缺血性扩张型心肌病，检出BAG3与FLNC双基因可能致病变异，家系呈现显著表型异质性，提示双基因致病需谨慎解读。
AI.motivation: 扩张型心肌病（DCM）遗传异质性强，对于呈家族聚集性心力衰竭死亡的非缺血性重症DCM，基因检测与家系分析有助于明确病因并指导级联筛查，但双基因变异共存时的致病性解释尚缺乏证据。
AI.method: 个案报道。先证者为40岁女性，表现为上呼吸道感染后进行性呼吸困难、胸闷和心悸。通过超声心动图、冠状动脉造影、心血管磁共振（CMR）、系列心肌损伤标志物、指南导向药物治疗及全外显子组测序进行评价，并对家系成员（女儿及两名子女）进行变异携带状态验证。主要观察指标包括LVEF、NT-proBNP、CMR晚期钆增强（LGE）模式、基因变异及家系表型。
AI.result: 超声示LVEF约20%，左房扩大、功能性二尖瓣反流及少量心包积液；冠状动脉造影排除阻塞性冠心病；CMR示左室整体运动减弱及乳头肌水平前/侧壁非缺血性LGE。心肌肌钙蛋白I及心肌酶谱持续正常。指南导向治疗后NT-proBNP由4154降至828 pg/mL，但2个月时LVEF仍为25%，QTc 479 ms，室性早搏持续存在。全外显子组测序检出BAG3（NM_004281.4:c.180+1G>T）和FLNC（NM_001458.5:c.761_779del, p.(Leu254Profs*14)）杂合可能致病变异；女儿携带BAG3变异，两名子女均未携带FLNC变异。家系中父亲、弟弟成年期及侄子儿童期有心力衰竭相关死亡史。
AI.conclusion: 该家系支持复杂家族性非缺血性DCM伴显著可变表现度；BAG3与FLNC变异共存应视为假设生成而非双基因因果关系的证据。感染相关急性失代偿、心肌损伤标志物持续正常、非缺血性LGE及炎症CMR序列不完整更倾向于谨慎解读，而非确诊心肌炎。临床需系列影像学、节律监测、个体化器械风险评估及对基因阳性亲属的随访。

summary_zh:
背景：扩张型心肌病（DCM）具有遗传异质性。在伴有心力衰竭死亡家族聚集性的严重非缺血性DCM中，基因检测和系谱分析可能有助于明确病因并指导级联筛查。

病例呈现：一名40岁女性在上呼吸道感染后出现进行性呼吸困难、胸闷和心悸。超声心动图显示严重左心室收缩功能障碍[左心室射血分数（LVEF）约20%]、左心房扩大、功能性二尖瓣反流和少量心包积液。连续检测心肌肌钙蛋白I和心肌酶谱均在参考范围内。冠状动脉造影排除了阻塞性冠状动脉疾病。心血管磁共振（CMR）显示左心室整体运动减弱，临床报告为乳头肌水平累及前壁/侧壁的非缺血性晚期钆增强模式。由于心脏生物标志物持续正常且未采集专用的炎症CMR序列，无法确认活动性心肌炎。指南指导的药物治疗使NT-proBNP从4154 pg/mL降至828 pg/mL，尽管血管紧张素受体-脑啡肽酶抑制剂治疗因症状性低血压而受限。2个月时，症状和日常活动耐量改善，但LVEF仍为25%，QTc为479 ms，室性早搏持续存在。全外显子组测序鉴定出BAG3（NM_004281.4:c.180 + 1G > T）和FLNC [NM_001458.5:c.761_779del, p.(Leu254Profs*14)]的杂合可能致病性变异。女儿携带BAG3变异，而两名子女均为FLNC阴性。先证者报告其父亲和弟弟在成年期、一名侄子在儿童期因心力衰竭相关死亡。

结论：这些发现支持具有显著可变表现度的复杂家族性非缺血性DCM。共存的BAG3和FLNC变异应解释为提出假设而非双基因因果关系的证据。感染相关的急性失代偿、持续正常的心脏损伤生物标志物、非缺血性LGE以及不完整的炎症CMR特征支持谨慎解释而非心肌炎的明确诊断。系列影像学、心律监测、个体化器械风险评估以及基因型阳性亲属的随访至关重要。

title: The Effect of S616L, a CPVT1-Associated Mutation, on the Stability and Structure of Human Cardiac RyR2.
summary: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia type 1 (CPVT1) is a heritable genetic disease caused by mutations to hRyR2, the cardiac isoform of the human ryanodine receptor. One such mutation, S616L, is found in the α-helical part (NSol) of the hRyR2 N-terminal domain (NTD) close to a three-way junction between the NTD, junctional solenoid (JSol), and bridging solenoid (BSol) domains. In this study, we use molecular dynamics simulation to study the effect of S616L on the residues of this junction. We find that the mutation slightly weakens the interface between the N-terminal domain and the bridging solenoid by changing the preferred conformation of the residues at the interface, thereby promoting a slight opening between these domains. In addition, we determined the impact of this mutation on the biophysical and biochemical properties of a 655-residue fragment containing the entire hRyR2 N-terminal domain, finding that it slightly increases the thermal stability of the fragment.

AI.tldr: CPVT1相关S616L突变通过改变hRyR2 N端结构域与桥接螺旋桨结构域界面残基构象，轻微削弱二者相互作用并促进结构域间开放，同时轻度增加N端片段的热稳定性。
AI.motivation: CPVT1由hRyR2突变引起，S616L位于N端结构域α螺旋区，邻近NTD、JSol和BSol三向连接处，该突变对结构稳定性和域间界面的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学模拟研究S616L对NTD-BSol界面残基的影响，并测定含全长hRyR2 N端结构域的655残基片段的生物物理和生化性质，摘要未报告样本量及具体统计方法。
AI.result: S616L突变改变界面残基偏好构象，轻微削弱NTD与BSol界面并促进域间轻微开放；同时轻度增加655残基N端片段的热稳定性，摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: S616L可能通过轻度破坏NTD-BSol界面稳定性及增加N端片段热稳定性影响hRyR2功能，为CPVT1机制提供结构线索，但结论基于模拟和片段实验，需进一步功能验证。

summary_zh: 儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速1型（CPVT1）是一种由hRyR2（人兰尼碱受体的心脏亚型）突变引起的遗传性疾病。其中一个突变S616L位于hRyR2 N端结构域（NTD）的α螺旋部分（NSol），靠近NTD、连接螺旋（JSol）和桥接螺旋（BSol）结构域之间的三向连接处。在本研究中，我们使用分子动力学模拟来研究S616L对该连接处残基的影响。我们发现该突变通过改变界面残基的偏好构象，轻微削弱了N端结构域与桥接螺旋之间的界面，从而促使这些结构域之间轻微打开。此外，我们确定了该突变对包含整个hRyR2 N端结构域的655个残基片段生物物理和生化性质的影响，发现它轻微增加了该片段的热稳定性。

title: Fight or Flight: A Multidisciplinary Approach to Diagnosis and Management of Mediastinal Paragangliomas.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Mediastinal paragangliomas are rare neuroendocrine tumors, leading to potentially invasive clinical investigation and inadequate staging. Functional secretory activity, high germline mutation rates, multifocal disease burden, and proximity to the great vessels demand a multidisciplinary approach. We describe our longitudinal multidisciplinary experience building a center of excellence model.

METHODS: We performed a retrospective single-center cohort study of 19 patients with mediastinal paraganglioma managed at a quaternary referral center, capturing demographics, imaging, preoperative testing, operative details, and perioperative outcomes.

RESULTS: There were 14 (73.7%) females with a median age of 46.3 years (IQR 38.5-57.6 years). Sixteen (84%) of 19 patients were referred from outside centers; 9 (47.3%) underwent biopsy before referral, with three (15.8%) experiencing catecholamine crisis, pneumothorax, or hemorrhage. Nine (47.4%) tumors were adjacent to the aorta, and seven (42.1%) adjacent to the pulmonary artery, with vascular involvement in 17(89.5%) of the 19 patients. Thirteen (68%) were functional and five (26.3%) had multifocal disease. Succinate dehydrogenase mutations were found in 63.6% of patients tested. Cardiopulmonary bypass was required in 63.2%, with zero 30-day mortality. Postoperative complications occurred in 47.4%, predominantly atrial arrhythmia. Median hospital stay was four days. Four patients developed local recurrence at a median recurrence-free survival of 16.9 months, all with positive margins or multifocal disease.

CONCLUSIONS: Mediastinal paragangliomas can be safely resected within a multidisciplinary center of excellence. Early recognition, avoidance of uninformed biopsy, functional staging, preoperative alpha blockade, and tumor profiling and genetic evaluation with genetic counseling are essential components.

AI.motivation: 纵隔副神经节瘤是罕见神经内分泌肿瘤，易导致侵入性检查及分期不足；其功能性分泌、高胚系突变率、多灶病变及邻近大血管等特点需要多学科管理，但既往缺乏纵向多学科经验总结。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入19例在四级转诊中心管理的纵隔副神经节瘤患者，收集人口学、影像、术前检查、手术细节及围术期结局。
AI.result: 女性14例（73.7%），中位年龄46.3岁（IQR 38.5-57.6）；16例（84%）由外院转诊，9例（47.3%）转诊前接受活检，其中3例（15.8%）发生儿茶酚胺危象、气胸或出血。9例（47.4%）肿瘤邻近主动脉，7例（42.1%）邻近肺动脉，17例（89.5%）有血管受累。13例（68%）为功能性，5例（26.3%）为多灶病变。接受检测者中63.6%发现琥珀酸脱氢酶突变。63.2%需体外循环，30天死亡率为零。术后并发症47.4%，以房性心律失常为主。中位住院4天。4例（21.1%）局部复发，中位无复发生存期16.9个月，均伴切缘阳性或多灶病变。
AI.conclusion: 纵隔副神经节瘤在多学科卓越中心可安全切除，早期识别、避免盲目活检、功能分期、术前α受体阻滞、肿瘤分子分型及遗传咨询与检测是关键环节；但术后房性心律失常常见，切缘阳性或多灶病变者需密切监测复发。

summary_zh:
背景：纵隔副神经节瘤是罕见的神经内分泌肿瘤，导致可能具有侵入性的临床检查和分期不足。功能性分泌活性、高胚系突变率、多灶性疾病负担以及与大血管的邻近关系需要多学科方法。我们描述了我们在建立卓越中心模式方面的纵向多学科经验。

方法：我们进行了一项回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入在四级转诊中心管理的19例纵隔副神经节瘤患者，收集人口统计学、影像学、术前检查、手术细节和围手术期结局。

结果：女性14例（73.7%），中位年龄46.3岁（IQR 38.5-57.6岁）。19例患者中16例（84%）由外院转诊；9例（47.3%）在转诊前接受了活检，其中3例（15.8%）出现儿茶酚胺危象、气胸或出血。9例（47.4%）肿瘤邻近主动脉，7例（42.1%）邻近肺动脉，19例患者中17例（89.5%）存在血管受累。13例（68%）为功能性，5例（26.3%）为多灶性疾病。在接受检测的患者中，63.6%发现琥珀酸脱氢酶突变。63.2%需要体外循环，30天死亡率为零。术后并发症发生率为47.4%，主要为房性心律失常。中位住院时间为4天。4例患者出现局部复发，中位无复发生存期为16.9个月，均伴有切缘阳性或多灶性疾病。

结论：纵隔副神经节瘤可以在多学科卓越中心内安全切除。早期识别、避免不知情的活检、功能分期、术前α受体阻滞以及肿瘤分析和遗传评估与遗传咨询是必不可少的组成部分。

title: An Intelligent Deep Learning Framework for Cardiac Arrhythmia Detection and Risk Prediction
summary: Abstract Cardiac Arrhythmia detection using continuous ECG monitoring is challenging because abnormal heartbeats occur irregularly, and their patterns may vary from one person to another. ECG signals can also contain noise caused by body movements, muscle activity, and baseline variations, which can affect the accuracy of detection. To address these challenges, this project proposes an intelligent deep learning framework that combines a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network, and an Attention Mechanism to detect and classify heartbeats into five AAMI classes. The CNN extracts important features from ECG signals, while the BiLSTM learns the sequential patterns of heartbeats. The CNN extracts important features from ECG signals, particularly the QRS complex, while reducing the influence of less relevant information and noise. To improve the interpretability of the results, a gradient-based Explainable AI (XAI) method is used to generate saliency heatmaps that highlight important regions of the ECG signals. The framework also includes a risk stratification module that categorizes detected cases into low, medium, and high-risk levels based on predefined criteria. The proposed model is evaluated using the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, with ECG signals segmented into 0.6 second windows around the R-peaks. The target is to achieve high classification accuracy while providing understandable results and useful risk information. This framework aims to support continuous ECG monitoring and assist healthcare professionals in identifying abnormal heartbeat more efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种结合1D CNN、BiLSTM和注意力机制的深度学习框架，用于ECG心搏五分类（AAMI标准）并附加风险分层，在MIT-BIH数据库上以0.6秒R峰窗口进行验证，目标为高分类准确率与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 连续ECG监测中的心律失常检测面临异常心搏不规则出现、个体间模式差异大以及体动、肌电和基线漂移等噪声干扰的挑战，影响检测准确性；同时临床需要可解释的结果和风险信息以辅助决策。
AI.method: 研究为方法学开发与验证性研究，使用MIT-BIH心律失常数据库，将ECG信号以R峰为中心分割为0.6秒窗口；构建1D CNN提取QRS复合波等特征、BiLSTM学习心搏序列模式、注意力机制增强关键信息，输出按AAMI标准分为五类心搏；采用梯度类可解释AI方法生成显著性热图；并设风险分层模块按预设标准将检出病例分为低、中、高危。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义细节及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告分类准确率、灵敏度、特异度、AUC等具体性能数值及置信区间或P值，也未报告风险分层模块的验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架旨在支持连续ECG监测并帮助医疗人员更高效识别异常心搏，同时通过可解释性热图和风险分层提升临床可用性；但摘要未提供定量性能数据，其实际准确性、泛化能力及临床效用尚需在独立数据集中验证。

summary_zh: 摘要 使用连续心电监测进行心律失常检测具有挑战性，因为异常心跳不规则发生，且其模式可能因人而异。心电信号还可能包含由身体运动、肌肉活动和基线漂移引起的噪声，这会影响检测的准确性。为应对这些挑战，本项目提出了一种智能深度学习框架，该框架结合了一维卷积神经网络（1D CNN）、双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）网络和注意力机制，以检测心跳并将其分为五个AAMI类别。CNN从心电信号中提取重要特征，而BiLSTM学习心跳的序列模式。CNN从心电信号中提取重要特征，特别是QRS波群，同时减少较不相关信息与噪声的影响。为提高结果的可解释性，采用基于梯度的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法生成显著性热图，以突出心电信号的重要区域。该框架还包括一个风险分层模块，根据预定义标准将检测到的病例分为低、中、高风险等级。所提出的模型使用MIT-BIH心律失常数据库进行评估，心电信号在R波峰周围被分割为0.6秒的窗口。目标是在提供可理解的结果和有用的风险信息的同时实现高分类准确率。该框架旨在支持连续心电监测，并帮助医疗专业人员更高效地识别异常心跳。
